נהם.def:
H5099. naham

נַ֫הַם‎ noun [masculine] growling of lion; — figurative of king's wrath Prov 19:12, compare 20:2.

נהמה.def:
H5100. nehamah

[נְהָמָה‎] noun feminine growling, groaning; — only construct נָָֽהֲמַת‎ :

1 Isa 5:30 of sea, in simile of growling of Assyr. Lion.

2 figurative groaning Psa 38:9 of heart (מִנ ׳שָׁאַָ֫גְתִּי‎).

נהק.def:
H5101. nahaq

[נָהַק‎] verb bray, cry (Late Hebrew id.; Arabic bray (of ass); Aramaic נְהַק‎ cry out (of men), נְהִיקָא‎ braying); —

Qal Imperfect יִנְהַק‎ Job 6:5 of wild ass; יִנְהָ֑קוּ‎ 30:7 of cries of destitute outcasts.

נהר.def:
H5102. nahar

I. [נָהַר‎] verb flow, stream (Arabic run, flow; perhaps denominative from river, and this loan-word (compare Frä285); Assyrian nûru, stream, river, DlHWB 440; Aramaic , נַהֲרָא‎ river); —

Qal Perfect3plural consecutive וְנָָֽהֲרוּ‎ Isa 2:2 2t.; Imperfect3masculine plural יִנְהֲרוּ‎ Jer 51:44; — flow, stream only figurative: of restored Israel streaming י ׳אֶלטֿוּב וגו ׳עַלדָּֿגָן‎ 31:12; nations to (אֶלֿ‎) Bel 51:44; to temple-hill at Jerusalem Isa 2:2 (אֵלָיו‎) = Micah 4:1 (עָלָיו‎).

II. נָהַר‎ verb shine, beam (Aramaic) (Late Hebrew id., especially in derivatives; Assyrian nûru, light, DlHWB 440; Arabic daytime, day, daytime; Aramaic shine, נְהַר‎ id.; Palmyrene נהירא‎ illustrious, e.g. VogPalm. No. 22); —

Qal Perfect2feminine singular consecutive וְנָהַרְתְּ‎ Isa 60:5; 3plural נָהָ֑רוּ‎ Psa 34:6; — beam, be radiant, figurative of joy: וְנ ׳תִּרְאִי‎ Isa 60:5, וְנ אֵלָיו ׳הִבִּיטוּ‎ Psa 34:6 (read וּנְהָרוּ ׳הַבּ,‎, see ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Che Bae Du).

נְהַר‎14 noun masculineDan 7:10 river (see Biblical Hebrew I. נהר‎); — absolute ׳נ‎ 7:10; emphatic נַהֲרָה‎ Ezra 4:10 +, אָ֯‎, 4:16; — river, usually of Euphrase, in phrase נ ׳עֲבַר‎ 4:10-11, 16 10t. Ezra; ׳נ דִּינֿוּר‎ Dan 7:10 a river of fire, in vision.

נהרה.def:
H5105. neharah

נְהָרָה‎ noun feminine light, daylight (as Aramaic נְהוֺרָא‎ masculine); — נ עָלָיו ׳וְאַלתּֿוֺפַע‎ Job 3:4 (opposed to חשֶׁךְ‎).

נוא.def:
H1961. hayah

הָיָה‎3570 verb fall out, come to pass, become, be (SI1; SI6 היה‎, ib3 הית‎; parallel form of הוה‎, Arabic , Aramaic הֲוָא‎, ; see הָוָה‎ above) —

Qal Perfect3masculine singular הָיָה‎ Gen 3:1 +; וְהָיָה‎ consecutive 4:14 +; 3 feminine singular הָֽיְתָה‎ 1:2 +; הָיָ֑תָה‎ Isa 14:24 3t.; וְהָֽיְתָה‎ consecutive Gen 9:13 +; והית‎2Kin 9:37 Kt (Qr וְהָֽיְתָה‎); 2 masculine singular הָיִיתָ‎ Deut 5:15 +; 1 singular הָיִיתִי‎Gen 31:40; 3 plural הָיוּ‎ 6:4 +; 2 masculine plural ם הֱיִיתֶ‎ Exod 22:20 +; וִהְיִיתֶם‎ consecutive Gen 3:5 +; 1 plural הָיִינוּ‎Isa 1:9 +; etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular יִהְיֶה‎ Gen 1:29 +; jussive יְהִי‎1:3 +; יֶהִ֑י‎ Ezek 16:15; וִיהִי‎Gen 1:6 +; וַיְהִי‎ 1:3 +; וַיֶּ֑הִי‎ Psa 33:9; Ezek 16:19; 3feminine singular תִּהְיֶה‎ Gen 21:30 +; 1 singular אֶהְיֶה‎ Exod 3:12 +; וָאֶהְיֶה‎2Sam 7:6 9t.; וָאֱהִי‎ Judg 18:4 12t.; 3 masculine plural יִהְיוּ‎ Gen 6:19 +; 3 feminine plural תִּהְיֶינָה‎Isa 16:2 19t.; תִּהְיֶין֣‎Gen 41:36 11t.; וְתִהְיֶנָה‎ Jer 18:21; 48:6; וַתִּהְיֶינָה‎ 2Sam 20:3 6t.; וַתִּהְיֶיןָ‎Gen 26:35; 1Sam 25:43; וַתִּהְיֶנָה‎ 1Chr 7:15; 2masculine plural תִהְיוּ‎ Gen 34:15 +; תִהְיוּן‎ Exod 22:20; 1plural נִהְיֶה‎ Gen 38:23 +; וַנִּהְיֶה‎2Sam 11:23; Jer 44:17; וַנְּהִי‎ Num 13:33; Isa 64:5, etc.; Imperative masculine singular הֱיֵה‎ Exod 18:19 +; feminine singular הֲיִי‎Gen 24:60; masculine plural הֱיוּ‎Exod 19:15; Num 16:16, וִהְיוּ‎ 1Sam 4:9 6t.; Infinitive absolute הָיוֺ‎ Gen 18:18 3t.; הָיֹה‎ 1Kin 13:32; Ezek 1:3; construct הֱיוֺת‎ Gen 2:18 +, so read probably also for הֱיֵה‎ Ezek 21:15 compare Sm Köi. p. 600 f. (Co em. היהלֿה‎ to הָהֵל‎ shine, glitter); with prefix בִּהְיוֺת‎ Exod 5:13 +, בִּהְיֹת‎ 19:16 +; לִהְיוֺת‎ Gen 10:8 +, לִהְיֹת‎ Exod 23:1 +; suffix הֱיוֺתִי‎ Jonah 4:2; הֱיוֺתְךָ‎ Judg 18:19 (twice in verse); לִהְיֹתְךָ‎ Deut 26:10, etc.; Participle feminine הוֺיָה‎ Exod 9:3.

I. 1. a. Fall out, happen הַדָּבָר מֶההָֿיָה‎ 1Sam 4:16 how has the matter fallen out, (gone, turned out) ? so 2Sam 1:4; לוֺ מֶההָֿיָה‎ Exod 32:1, 23 (both J E) what has happened to him? compare 1Sam 10:12; לָנוּ הָיָה הוּא מִקְרֶה‎ 6:9 a chance it is that has befallen us; also כֵּן וַיְהִילֿוֺ‎ 2Kin 7:20 and so it happened to him, compare וַיְהִיכֵֿן‎ below

b. occur, take place, come about, come to pass: — מַגֵּפָה בָּעָם הָֽיְתָה גְדוֺלָה‎ 1Sam 4:17 a great slaughter has taken place among the people, compare 2Sam 17:9; אֶפְרַיִם בְּיַעַר הַמִּלְחָמָה וַתְּהִי‎ 18:6 and the battle took place in the wood of Ephraim (on אפרים‎ compare Klo Dr); Josh 22:17 (P; of plague); אָלָה נָא תְּהִי‎ Gen 26:28 (J) let an oath take place (be taken) so Judg 21:5; compare 2Kin 17:7 (si vera lectio), Ezek 16:34; especially late, 2Chr 29:36; 32:31; Eccl 1:9-10, 3:22; 8:7; 10:14 etc.; often of fulfilment of prediction, command, expectation, etc.: — הָיָה כֵּן‎ Gen 41:3 (E) so it came to pass, 2Sam 13:25, וַיְהִיכֵֿן‎ Judg 6:38; 2Kin 15:12; Isa 29:5, & especially וַיְהִיכֵֿן‎ Gen 1:7, 9, 11, 15, 24, 30 (all P) +; כִדְבָרֶ֑ךָ יְהִי‎ 30:34 let it be as thou sayest, Zech 6:15, see also יִהְיֶה וְלֹא תָקוּם לֹא‎ Isa 7:7 it shall not arise (be realized) & shall not come about, Isaiah 14:34; (so often בּוֺא‎ q. v. 2c, p. 98 above)

2 especially & very often, come about, come to pass followed by substantive (subject) clause almost always + modifying (usually temporal) clause or phrase:

a. ( I) וַיְהִי‎ and it came to pass that, most often (c. 292 t.) followed by (a) Imperfect consecutive: a. with Infinitive with כְּ‎ temporal Gen 12:14; 19:17 (both J) + 75 t. + Est 3:4 Qr (Hexateuch chiefly J, — so always Genesis, — & J E; P only Exod 16:10, D only Deut 5:20; 31:24; Josh 5:1; 9:1; 27t. in Kings), — somewhat different is 2Kin 7:18; β. with Infinitive with בְּ‎ Gen 4:8; 11:2 (both J) + 29 t. + Est 3:4 Kt (in Hexateuch 10 t. J E; 3 t. P, Gen 19:29; Exod 34:29; Num 17:7; not in D); γ. with בְּ‎ followed by temporal noun (בֹּקֶר יוֺם,‎, etc.) Gen 21:22 (E) 26:32 (J) + 45 t. (Hes 14 t. J E; 3 t. P, Exod 6:28; 16:13; Num 7:1; not D); δ. לְ‎ temporal 1Sam 1:20; 2Sam 13:23; 1Kin 20:26; 1Chr 20:1; ε. כְּ‎ temporal Gen 39:11; 1Sam 25:38; ζ. מִן‎ temporal namely: מֵאָז‎ Gen 39:5, מִיּוֺם‎ 1Sam 7:2; compare 30:25, מִיָּמִים‎ Judg 11:4; 15:1, מִקֵּץ‎ Gen 4:3; 8:6 6t., מִקְצֵה‎ Josh 3:2; 2Kin 8:3; Ezek 3:16, especially מִמָּחֳרָת‎ Gen 19:34; Exod 18:13 11t.; η. כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ temporal Gen 12:11 (J) 20:13 (E) + 31 t. (Hexateuch 13 t. J E, Deut 2:16, not P), characteristic of Nehemiah's memoris, Nehemiah 3:33; Neh 4:1; 4:6; 4:9; 6:1, 16; 7:1; 13:19; θ. with כִּי‎ temporal Gen 6:1 (J) Exod 3:21 (E) + 14 t. + Judg 16:25 Kt; ι. אַחֲרֵי‎ temporal Gen 22:20 (J) + 13 t., אַחַר‎ 39:7; Job 42:7, אַחֲרֵיכֵֿן‎ Judg 16:14 6t.; κ. followed by עַד‎ temporal 1Sam 14:19 (on which compare Dr); compare וְעַדכֹּֿה עַדכֹּֿה‎ 1Kin 18:45; λ. with combinations; as בְּ‎ with temporal noun + בְּ‎ Infinitive Gen 34:25; Exod 19:16; 1Sam 25:37; בְּ‎ Infinitive + כְּ‎ Infinitive Josh 3:14; double preposition חֳדָשִׁים כְּמִשְּׁלשׁ‎ Gen 38:24; מִקְצֵה‎ + אֲשֶׁר אַחֲרֵי‎ Josh 9:16; מִיָּמִים‎ + id. 23:1; μ. other unusual constructions under this head are: those where temporal idea is expressed by a circumstantial clause Isa 22:7; 1Kin 13:20; 2Kin 8:21 (Dr§ 165, & Οβς.) = 2Chr 21:9; those with indefinite כֹּל‎ 1Sam 10:11; 2Sam 2:23; 15:2, or with participle = rel. clause 1Sam 11:1 (on all see Dr§ 78 n. & Sm); quite unique is 1Kin 16:31, with וגו ׳לָכְתּוֺ הֲנָקֵל‎in place of temporal clause (b) וַיְהִי‎ sometimes followed by simple Perfect, with a negative Gen 39:10 (with כְּ‎ Infinitive), Exod 13:17 (with בְּ‎ Infinitive) 2Kin 12:7; 17:25 (both with בְּ‎ temporal); & without negative, Gen 8:13 (P) 14:1 +, usually with בְּ‎ temporal (38 t.), Hexateuch chiefly P; rarely with other preposition & adverb as above; note especially מִדֵּי‎ followed by Infinitive 1Sam 18:30; 2Chr 12:11; sometimes the subject of following Perfect precedes it with וְ‎, as Gen 22:1; 41:1; 1Sam 18:19; 30:1; 2Kin 2:9; 4:40 +; note especially 2Sam 17:27 where several subject & also several objects precede the Perfect (compare Dr); in these cases temporal modifier is occasionally a circumstantial clause 13:30; 1Kin 8:10; 2Kin 19:37 = Isa 37:38; rarely subject precedes Perfect without וְ‎ 1Kin 11:4; 21:1, compare subject preceding Participle without וְ‎ Neh 4:10; in 2Chr 8:1 the object (with וְ‎) precedes what is apparently the principal verb (c) וַיְהִי‎ followed by וְהִנֵּה‎ Gen 24:15 (J; טֶרֶם‎ in temporal clause), 29:25 (E), 38:27 (J, both בְּ‎ temporal) 38:29 (כְּ‎ Participle), 1Sam 13:10 (כְּ‎ Infinitive); also 2Sam 1:2; 13:36; 15:32 (circumstantial clause) 2Kin 2:11 (id.), 3:20; 13:21 (circumstantial clause). (d) rarely וַיְהִי‎ (in this sense) followed by other constructions: יִתֵּן אָז‎ 1Kin 9:10 (with מִקְצֵה‎); Imperfect frequentative 14:28 (with מִדֵּיבּֿאֹ‎), 2Kin 4:8 (with עָבְרוֺ מִדֵּי‎) Jer 36:23 (with כְּ‎ Infinitive); Perfect consecutive frequentative 2Chr 24:11 (with בְּ‎ temporal). (2) rarely also Perfect with וְ‎ conjunctive וְהָיָה‎ (compare Dr§ 183) followed by Imperfect consecutive as subject clause: 1Sam 1:12 (c. several circumstantial clause), 10:9 (with כְּ‎ Infinitive) 2Kin 3:15 (id.), 1Sam 17:48 (with כִּי‎), Jer 37:11 (with בְּ‎ Infinitive), Amos 7:2 (with אִם‎ temporal); also Jer 3:9 (apparently with מִן‎ causative, but obscure); 1Sam 13:22 (with בְּ‎ temporal) is followed by וְלֹא‎ & Perfect as well as Imperfect consecutive

b. less often וְהָיָה‎ Perfect consecutive and it shall come to pass, or frequentative,came to pass (repeatedly, etc.) usually (a) followed by simple Imperfect (c. 100 t.): a. with בְּ‎ temporal Deut 21:16; 25:19 37t., (especially הַהוּא בַּיּוֺם‎ Hosea 2:18; Hosea 2:33; Isa 7:18, 21, 23 21t.); β. with בְּ‎ local Ezek 47:23; Zech 13:8 compare also Hosea 2:1 (אֲשֶׁר בִּמְקוֺם‎, but perhaps = instead of, compare VB); γ. with indefinite rel. clause, or its equivalents (כֹּל‎ indefinite, etc.), compare Dr§ 121, Obs. 1: Gen 4:14; Numbers 17:20; Deut 12:11; 18:19; Josh 7:14-15, Judg 7:4; 1Sam 2:36; 17:25; 2Sam 15:35; 1Kin 19:17; 20:6; Isa 4:3; 24:18; Nahum 3:7; Jer 27:8; 42:4; Ezek 47:9; Zech 14:17; Joel 3:5; δ. with כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ Num 33:56; Deut 28:63; Josh 23:15; Judg 7:17; Isa 29:8; Jer 31:28; Zech 8:13; ε. less often with other modifying phrase: כְּ‎ Infinitive Exod 33:8-9, (both frequentative), Josh 3:13; 8:8; Jer 25:12; 51:63; בְּ‎ Infinitive Gen 9:14 (P) 2Kin 4:10; Ezek 44:17; אִם‎ of condition Deut 20:11 (+ 20:11 Dr§ 118 n.), also Josh 22:18, where the arrangement is peculiar, & the condition is expressed without אִם‎ (compare Dr§ 155); לְ‎ temporal Deut 23:12; מִקֵּץ‎ Isa 23:17; טֶרֶם‎ 65:24; בְּחָדְשׁוֺ חֹדֶשׁ מִדֵּי‎ 66:23, etc. (b) וְהָיָה‎ followed by Perfect consecutive (c. 85 t.): α. most often + clause with כִּי‎ temporal Gen 12:12; 46:33 (both J) Exod 1:10 (E) Deut 11:29; Isa 8:21 25t.; β. with אִם‎ Exod 4:8-9, Num 15:24; Deut 11:13-14t.; also Gen 38:9; Num 21:9 (both frequentative); γ. with בְּ‎ temporal Gen 30:41 (frequentative) 47:24 (but compare Ol Di) Exod 16:5 11t.; δ. with indefinite rel. clause or equivalent (Dr§ 121 Obs. 1): Gen 24:14; Num 10:32 (Dr§ 118 n.) 21:18; Deut 21:3; Judg 11:31; 19:30; Zech 14:16; ε. occasionally with other modifying phrase: כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ Gen 27:40 +; כְּ‎ Infinitive 44:31 +; בְּ‎ Infinitive Exod 33:22 +; מִקֵּץ‎ 2Sam 14:26; עֵקֶב‎ causative Deut 7:12; also (c) followed by וְלֹא‎ + simple Imperfect Exod 3:21 (with כִּי‎ temporal). (d) וְהָיָה‎ followed by Imperative (very rare) Deut 6:10 (with כִּי‎ temporal), 1Sam 10:7 (with כִּי‎), compare 29:10, compare Perfect consecutive in command 3:9 (with אִם‎). (e) וְהָיָה‎ followed by simple Perfect (also very rare) Deut 8:19 (with אִם‎). (f) וְהָיָה‎ followed by clause without verb: Gen 24:43; Josh 2:19; 1Kin 18:24 (all with indefinite rel. modifier, or equivalents, see (a) γ, (b) δ, above). (g) וְהָיָה‎ (ו‎ conjunctive) followed by Imperfect consecutive see a. (e) above

II. Come into being, become: —

1. a. absolute, in lively narrative, arise, appear, come גְדֹלָה צְעָקָה וַתְּהִי‎Ex 12:80 (J) and there arose a great cry in Egypt; וַיְהִיקֿוֺל‎ Ezek 1:25 (strike out Co compare Da), 37:7 (strike out ᵐ5 קוֺל‎ Co); הָֽרְוָחָה הָֽיְתָה כִּי‎ Exod 8:11 (J) Pharaoh saw that respite had come; Micah 7:4 now shall come their confusion (|| בוא‎); also of concrete objects בֶּעָנָן הַקֶּשֶׁת וְהָֽיְתָה‎ Gen 9:16 (P) and the bow shall appear in the clouds (|| וְנִרְאֲתָה‎) בּוֺ הָֽיְתָה לֹא וְרִמָּה‎ Exod 16:24 (P) and worms did not appear in it; of condition or action begun & continuing, as: famine Gen 12:10; 26:1 (twice in verse) (all J), 41:54 (E), Ruth 1:1; 2Sam 21:1; 2Kin 6:25; strife Gen 13:7-8, (J), Hab 1:3 (|| יִשָּׂא מָדוֺן‎); often of action of the elements, as the coming of hail Exod 9:18, 24, 26 (all J), thunder & lighting, etc., 19:16 (E), rain 1Kin 18:45, storm Jonah 1:4; especially of creative fiats אוֺר וַיְהִי אוֺר יְהִי‎ Gen 1:3 let light appear, and light appeared, compare 1:5; 1:8; 1:13; 1:19; 1:23; 1:31 (all P); also arise, come on the stage or scene, שַׁמְגַּר הָיָה וְאַחֲרָיו‎ Judg 3:31 and after him arose Shamgar (= וַיָּקָם‎ 10:1); further הָיָה וַעֲלָטָה‎ Gen 15:17 (JE) and darkness came on; הָיָה הַבֹּקֶר‎ Exod 10:13 (J) the morning came, 19:16 (E); הַיּוֺם וַיְהִי‎ 1Sam 1:4 and the day came, when (see Dr), 14:1; 2Kin 4:8, 11, 18; Job 1:6, 18; 2:1.

b. followed by preposition: אַלתְּֿהִיבֿוֺ וְיָדֵנוּ בְּ,‎ Gen 37:27 (J) but our hand, let it not come upon him, of hand of ׳יּ‎ 1Sam 5:9; 7:13; 12:15 + (all in hostile sense); י בִּרְכַּת ׳וַיְהִי יֶשׁלֿוֺ בְּכָלשֲֶֿֿׁר‎ Gen 39:5 (J) and the blessing of ׳י‎ came into (on) all that he had; but also of plague Exod 12:13 (P); followed by עַלהָֿאָרֶץ הָיוּ הַמַּבּוּל וּמֵי עַל,‎ Gen 7:10 (J) that the waters of the flood came upon the earth; כֻלָּ֑נָה הָיוּ עָלַי‎ 42:36 (E) 9:2 (P) fear shall come upon, compare 35:25 (P) 2Chr 14:13; 17:19; 20:29 +; of wrath Josh 22:20; 1Kin 3:27; so of Saul's evil spirit from God 1Sam 16:16, 23; 19:9 (אֶל‎); but followed by עַל‎ also in good sense י רוּחַ עָלָיו ׳וַתְּהִי‎ conferring strength & efficiency Judg 3:10; 11:29 (היה‎ = צלח‎ 14:6 + often), compare Num 24:2 (JE) of prophetic power; (on י יַד לָיו ׳וַתְּהִי‎ 2Kin 3:15; Ezek 3:22 and the like, see יָד‎); עָלֵינוּ הָֽיְתָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַד‎ Ezra 8:31, so Psa 80:18; even דָּוִד עַלרֿאֹשׁ וַתְּהִי‎ 2Sam 12:30 and it (the crown, עֲטֶרֶת‎) came (i.e. was put, set) on David's head; with a different meaning הַשָּׁ֑עַר עַדמֶּֿתַח עֲלֵיהֶם וַנִּהְיֶה‎ 11:23 and we were close upon them even to the gateway (compare We Dr); come, go, follow (followed by אַחֲרֵי‎) i.e. take the side of, adhere to, Exod 23:2 (JE) 1Sam 12:14; 2Sam 2:10; 1Kin 12:20; 16:21; followed by לְ‎ of blessings Gen 49:26 (poem); of judgement, punishment Jer 40:3 especially אֶל דבר֗֗֗ ויהי‎ and the word of ... came unto: word of Samuel 1Sam 4:1; usually word of God (or ׳י‎) Gen 15:1; 1Sam 15:10 +; constantly in prophets: Hosea 1:1; Micah 1:1 etc.; especially Jeremiah & Ezekiel: Jer 1:4, 11, 13; 2:1; 13:8 +; Ezek 3:16; 6:1; 7:1; 11:14; 11:17; 11:21; Ezekiel 11:26; 12:1, 8 +; so also absolute הַזֶּה הַמַּשָּׂא הָיָה‎ Isa 14:28 in the death-year of king Ahaz came this utterance; also followed by מִן‎; יִהְיוּ מִמֶּנָּה עַמִּים מַלְכֵי‎ Gen 17:16 (P), מִמֶּ֑ךָּ יִהְיֶה גּוֺיִם וּקְהַל‎ 35:11 (P), מִמֶּנּוּ אַדִּירוֺ וְהָיָה‎ Jer 30:21 (|| יֵצֵא מִקִּרְבּוֺ‎); הֶעָפָר אֶל שָׁב וְהַכֹּל מִןהֶֿעָפָר הָיָה הַכֹּל‎ Eccl 3:20 all came from the dust, & all return unto the dust; ׳י צְבָאוֺת מֵאֵת גָּדוֺל קֶצֶף וַיְהִי‎ Zech 7:12.

2 become :

a. followed by predicate noun (to be viewed as implicit accusative Dr§ 161, 3 n., according to the Arabic usage WAG ii, § 41. 44. 74): כָּלחָֿ֑י אֵם הָֽיְתָה הִוא‎ Gen 3:20 (J) it was she that became the mother of all living; אֲדָמָה עֹבֵד הָיָה וְקַיִן צאֹן רֹעֵה הֶבֶל וַיְהִי‎4:2 (J) and Abel became a shepherd of flocks, while Cain became a tiller of ground; 2Sam 8:14; Micah 2:11 +?

b. followed by predicate adjective Gen 38:7; Exod 36:13 +; compare Gen 37:20 let us see what his dream will become (turn out to be, signify);

c. become like (כְּ‎), כֵּאלֹהִים וִהְיִיתֶם‎ Gen 3:5 and ye shall become like gods compare 3:22, Num 11:1 (JE), Hosea 2:1; 7:11; Isa 9:18; 1Kin 7:8; Zech 9:7 +; compare Gen 15:5 so (כֹּה‎) shall thy seed become; specifically of likeness in punishment Isa 1:9; 1Sam 17:36 +; also with כְּ‎ repeated כַּכֹּהֵן כָעָם וְהָיָה‎ Hosea 4:9 and the people shall become like the priest (literally, and the like of the people shall become the like of the priest), so especially Isa 24:2 (6 pairs of words as above); כָּרָשָׁע כַצַּדִּיק וְהָיָה‎ Gen 18:25 (J), see כְּ‎. b +

c Gen 27:32 his hands had become like the hands of Esau his brother, hairy.

d. followed by predicate + לְ‎ person לְבֶןאֲֿדֹנֶיךָ אִשָּׁה וּתְהִי‎ Gen 24:51 (J) and let her become wife to the son of thy lord, 1Sam 16:21; 1Kin 11:25; Psa 89:42; 1Chr 18:6 +; = be instituted, estanblished, לָהֶםחָקעֿוֺלָם וְהָיָה‎ Exod 30:21 (P) and it shall be established for them as a perpetual ordinance (compare f below).

e. followed by לְ‎ predicate: חַיָּה לְנֶפֶשׁ הָאָדָם וַיְהִי‎ Gen 2:7 (J) and the man became a living soul; רָאשִׁים לְאַרְבָּעָה וְהָיָה‎2:10 (J) and it became four heads; יִהְיֶהלְֿעָם גַּםהֿוּא‎ 48:19 (J) he too shall become a people; לַאֲנָשִׁים וִהְיוּ‎ 1Sam 4:9 and become (shew yourselves to be) men (|| הִתְחַזְּקוּ‎; compare with double לְ‎,

f. below); Zeph 1:13; Ezek 17:6; 47:12; Job 16:8; י ׳וְהָיָה עַלכָּֿלהָֿאָרֶץ עלמֶלֶךְ‎ Zech 14:9; עֹבֵד לְמַס וַיְהִי‎ Gen 49:15; Josh 16:10; so often; also in sense of turn into, be changed so as to become, לְנָחָשׁ וַיְהִי‎Exod 4:3 and it became a serpent, 4:4; 7:10; Isa 1:22; Deut 26:5 +; figurative לְמָ֑יִם וַיְהִי‎ Josh 7:5 and it (their heart) turned to water, so לְאֶבֶן הָיָה וְהוּא‎ 1Sam 25:37; or, serve as לִמְאוֺרֹת וְהָיוּ‎ Gen 1:15 (P) and they shall become (fulfil the function of, serve as) luminaries, compare 1:14; בְּרִית לְאוֺת וְהָיָה‎ 9:13; 17:11 (both P). feminine often with לְ‎ predicate + לְ‎ person: לְאָ֑בֶן הַלְּבֵנָה לָהֶם וַתְּהִי‎11:3 (J) and the bricks became (served as) stone for them; לְאִשָּׁה לִי וַתְּהִי‎ 20:12 (E) compare 24:67 (J) +, לְנָשִׁים דֹדֵיהֶן לַבְנֵי ֗֗֗ וְחָגְלָה מַחְלָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה‎ Num 36:11; לְאָכְלָה וְלָהֶם לְךָ וְהָיָה‎ 6:21 (P), Exod 2:10; 15:2; Judg 8:27; י ׳וְהָיָה לֵאלֹהִים לִי‎ Gen 28:21 (E); לְבֵן יִהְיֶהלִֿי וְהוּא לְאָב לוֺ אֶהְיֶה אֲנִי‎ 1Chr 17:3 +; = shew or prove oneself as לְבֶןחַֿיִל הֱיֵהלִֿי‎ 1Sam 18:17 shew thyself for me a valiant man (compare 4:9 e above); = be instituted, established (compare e above) לְחָקעֿוֺלָם וּלְבָנָיו לְאַהֲרֹן וְהָיָה‎ Exod 29:28 and it shall be instituted for Aaron and his sons as a perpetual ordinance; compare 29:9; Lev 10:15; לְדֹרֹתָם עוֺלָם לִכְהֻנַּת מָשְׁחָתָם לָהֶם לִהְיֹת וְהָֽיְתָה‎ Exod 40:15 (all P).

g. with עַל‎ and לְ‎ 1Sam 22:2 לְשָׂר עֲלֵיהֶם וַיְהִי‎ and he became over them prince.

h. sometimes with לְ‎ person only = become the property of, come into the possession of וְגו צאֹןוּֿבָקָר ׳וַיְהִילֿוֺ‎ Gen 12:15 (J), and he came to have flocks and herds etc., 26:14; 30:43; הַזָּ֑רַע יִהְיֶה לוֺ לֹא‎ 38:9 not his should the seed become; לי ׳וְהָיָה‎ Judg 11:31 it shall become Yah-weh's; Deut 10:9; Josh 13:29; 1Kin 10:26; 11:3 + often; so of a woman, as wife לְךָ תְּהִינָֿא‎ Judg 15:2 pray let her become thine, compare also לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ שִׁמְשׁוֺן אֵשֶׁת וַתְּהִי‎ 14:20, Hosea 3:3; Ruth 1:13; Lev 21:3; Deut 24:2; Jer 3:1; Ezek 16:8 (and also + לְנָשִׁים לְאִשָּׁה,‎ see f above)

III. Be (often with subordinate idea of becoming); —

1 exist, be in existence (i.e. originally have come into existence), הָיָה אֲשֶׁר כָּלהַֿיּמִים‎ 1Sam 1:28 all the days which he shall have been (lived, = חַי‎ Gen 5:5 etc., DrSm), Job 3:16; Isa 23:13; often with בְּ‎ local בָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה טֶרֶם הַשָּׂדֶה שִׂיחַ וְכֹל‎ Gen 2:5 (J) and there was not yet in the earth any shrub of the field; וגו אִישׁ הָיָה לֹא ׳וּבְאֵלֶּה‎ Num 26:64 (P) and among them there was not a man to be found, etc.; also וְאַחֲרָיו לְפָנָיו הַהוּא כַּיּוֺם הָיָה וְלֹא‎ Josh 10:14 (JE) & there hath not been a day like that before it nor since. compare 2Sam 14:25; 1Kin 18:5; 21:25; 1Ki 23:25; Neh 13:26 +; somewhat weaker, in the frequently introductory clause אִישׁ וַיְהִי‎ now there was a man Judg 13:2; 1Sam 1:1; 9:1; Num 9:6 (P), Job 1:1 +; on אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה‎ Exod 3:14 see יהוֺה‎.

2 abide, remain, continue (with word of place or time) בָּהָר משֶׁה וַיְהִי‎ Exod 24:18 and Moses remainded in the mount forty days, etc., so 34:28 (both J E), Judg 17:4, 12; 1Sam 6:1; 1Kin 11:20; 2Kin 11:3 2Chr 22:12 +; also Lev 22:27; 25:28 (both H), etc.; followed by עַד‎ temporal remain until Deut 22:2; 1Kin 11:40; 2Kin 15:5; 2Chr 5:9; 26:21; Dan 1:21 etc.; compare לְעוֺלָם יִהְיֶה הוּא‎ Eccl 3:14; so also of space followed by עַד‎ extend unto, as far as, Josh 19:10: of net beneath altar, Exod 27:5 shall reach as far as (עַד‎) the middle of the altar.

3 with word of locality, be in or at a place, be situated stand, lie; בַּשָּׂדֶה בִּהְיוֺתָם‎ Gen 4:8 (J) when they were in the field, בַּתְּחִלָּה אָהֳלֹה שָׁם אֲשֶׁרהָֿיָה הַמָּקוֺם‎ 13:3 (J) the place where his tent had stood at first; לִפְנֵיכֶם תִּהְיֶה וְהָאָרֶץ‎ 34:10 and the land, it lieth before you; compare Josh 19:1; Judg 7:1, 8; Micah 5:6; 5:7; followed by עַל‎ be, be found or situated upon Isa 30:25 and there shall be upon every high mountain etc., streams, water-courses; Ezek 37:27 and my dwelling-place shall be over them; figurative of guilt עָלָיךָ וְהָיָה דָּמִים‎ Deut 19:10 and blood (-guilt) be upon thee.

4 as copula, joining subject & predicate: —

a. followed by predicate adjective עֲרוּמִּים שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ‎ Gen 2:25, עָרוּם הָיָה וְהַנָּחָשׁ‎ 3:1, כֹּאֲבִים בִּהְיוֺתָם‎ 34:25, יְפֵהתֹֿאַר יוֺסֵף וַיְהִי‎ 39:6; Deut 23:15; Josh 19:9; Judg 11:1; Job 1:1, 3b 2Chr 7:21.

b. followed by predicate noun Gen 1:2; 9:18; 25:3; 36:14; 40:13; 1Sam 17:34, 42; 2Sam 8:10; 20:25; 1Kin 10:6; 2Kin 3:4; 5:1 (twice in verse); 1Chr 9:20; 11:20; 18:10; 26:10; 2Chr 13:7; יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ לֹאהָֿיָה כִּי‎18:32 (|| 1Kin 22:33 הוּא ישׂראל כִּילֹֿאמֶֿלֶךְ‎) +; often of age: שָׁנִים וְתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה בֶּןתִּֿשְׁעִים אַבְרָם וַיְהִי‎ Gen 17:1 (P) 2Kin 8:17; 14:2; 15:2, 33; 18:2; 2Chr 21:20; 27:8 +; followed by predicate Infinitive absolute (very anomal.) וְחָסוֺר הָלוֺךְ הָיוּ וְהַמַּיִם‎ Gen 8:5; = amount to, come to, in enumeration of days of life number of people, amounts of money, etc.: 5:4-5, 8, 11, 14; 9:29; 11:32; 23:1 +; Exod 38:24; Num 1:46, etc.

c. followed by adverb & adverbial phrase: לְבַדּוֺ הָאָדָם הֱיוֺת לֹאטֿוֺב‎Gen 2:18 (J) it is not good that the man be alone; כַּנָּשִׁים אֹרַה לְשָׂרָה לִהְיוֺת חָדַל‎ 18:11 (J).

d. followed by preposition: (a) be with, accompany with עִם‎, subject most often ׳י‎ or אלהים‎ with added idea of protection, aid Gen 26:3; 31:3; 39:10; 48:21; Josh 1:3; 6:27; Judg 1:19; 2:18; 1Sam 3:19; 18:12; 20:13; 1Kin 1:37; 1Chr 11:13; 2Chr 17:3; followed by עִמָּדִי‎ Gen 28:20; 31:5; 35:3; followed by עִם‎, human subject, of accompaniment עִםהַֿלְוִיִּם וְהָיָההַכֹּהֵןבֶּןאַֿהֲרֹן‎ Neh 10:39; 1Chr 11:12, read also in || 2Sam 23:9 (Th We Dr); = be on the side of 1Kin 1:8; with עִם‎ also = be near י ׳וּמַלְאַךְ האורנה עִםגֹּֿרֶן הָיָה‎ 2Sam 24:16 (compare Dr); also 13:20 implying sexual intercourse, so Gen 39:10 (perhaps gloss, compare Di); peculiar uses with עִם‎ are: יִשְׂרָאֵל עִםזִֿקְנֵי הָיָה וּדְבַראַֿבְנֵר‎ 2Sam 3:17 and the speech of A. had been with the elders of Israel, compare 1Kin 1:7; לִבְנוֺת אָבִּי דָּוִד עִםלְֿבַב וַיְהִי‎ 8:17 and it was with (i.e. in) the heart of David my father to build, = 2Chr 6:7 compare 1Kin 8:18 (twice in verse); 1Chr 22:7; 2Chr 6:8 (twice in verse); 24:4; also 1Kin 10:2 2Chr 9:1; (b) be with, followed by אֶת‎, subject אלהים ׳י,‎, Gen 21:20; 39:2, 21 but also with human subject אֶתמִֿקְנֵהוּ הָיוּ וּבָנָיוּ‎ 34:5, compare 1Sam 29:8 +; (c) followed by לְ‎ of possessor לִידִדִי הָיָה כֶּרֶם‎ Isa 5:1 all vineyard had my beloved, Gen 30:30 compare Exod 20:3 = Deut 5:7; Judg 18:27; 1Sam 9:2; 1Kin 5:6 + often (compare I.

2d, f, h); (d) followed by לְ‎ + other preposition: of boundary מֵעֲרוֺעֵר הַגְּבוּל לָהֶם וַיְהִי‎Josh 13:16, compare מִמַּחֲנַיִם גְבוּלָם וַיְהִי‎ 13:30; מִיַּרְדֵּן צָפנַָה לִפְאַת הַגְּבוּל לָהֶם וַוְהִי‎ 18:12, etc.; (e) followed by בְּ‎ be among, or of, Amos 1:1 who was one of the herdsmen, 1Kin 2:7 let them be among those eating, Prov 22:26; 23:20. 5 periphrastic conjug.:

a. היה‎ + participle, of continuous state, or condition, sometimes, especially late (compare Late Hebrew), of habit, with וַיְהִי‎ also of beginning and continuance (compare Dr§ 135, (5)): participle active Gen 39:22 (J), Exod 3:1 (E), 1Sam 2:11; 7:10; 18:9 (compare Dr) 18:14; 18:29; 2Sam 8:15 = 1Chr 18:14. Deut 28:29; Isa 30:20; 1Kin 5:1; 5:15; 1 Kings 5:24; 2Kin 6:5; 9:14; 2Chr 9:26; Ezra 4:4; Neh 1:4; 2:13; Dan 1:16 +; Gen 1:6 (P); אֶתיֿ יָרֵא ׳הָיָה‎ 1Kin 18:3; 2Kin 4:1; 2Chr 26:1; passive participle Josh 10:26; 1Kin 13:24; 22:35 בַּמֶּרְכָּבָה מָעֳמָד הָיָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ‎ (|| 2Chr 18:34 מַעֲמִיד הָיָה‎), Isa 2:2 = Micah 4:1, סָגוּר וְהָיָה‎ Ezek 44:2, ׳ה נַעֲשֶׂה‎ Neh 5:18, ה לֵאלֹהָיו ׳וְאָהוּב‎ 13:26; — on 2Sam 13:32 compare Dr.

b. followed by Infinitive with לְ‎ (Dr§ 208, 204): לְבָעֵר וְהָיָה‎ Isa 5:5 and it shall be to burn (is to be, is destined to be burned) etc.; הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וַיְהִי לָבוֺא‎ Gen 15:12 and the sun was about to set; לִסְגּוֺר הַשַּׁעַר וַיְהִי‎ Josh 2:5 and the gate was about to be shut; but also אֱלֹהִים לִדְרשׁ וַיְהִי‎2Chr 26:5 (nearly = וַיְהִי‎ + Participle)

Niph`al Perfect נִהְיָה‎ 1Kin 1:27 6t. + Micah 2:4 (compare below near the end); 3 feminine singular נִהָיְתָה‎ Judg 19:30 5t., נִהְיָ֑תָה‎ Exod 11:6; Jer 48:19; וְנִהְיָ֑תָה‎ consecutive Ezek 39:8 + 21:12 (strike out B Manuscripts ᵐ5‎ Co); 2 masculine singular נִהְיֵיתָ‎ Deut 27:9; 1singular ךּנהִךְייךתי‎ Dan 8:27; Participle feminine singular נִהְיָה‎ Prov 13:19; —

1 either, be done, be brought about, or occur, come to pass: in the strong expressions נ ׳לֹא כָּמֹהוּ אֲשֶׁר תֹסִף לֹא וְכָמֹהוּ‎ Exod 11:6 (J) a cry such as hath not occurred (been raised), and will not be again, compare Deut 4:32 (be done; || נִשְׁמַע‎), & Judg 19:30 (|| נִרְאֲתָה‎); — but simply intransitive Joel 2:2; Dan 12:1 & apparently Ezek 21:12 (|| בָּאָ֫ה‎; on text, however, see above) 39:8 (|| id.); — also הַזֹּאת הָרָעָה נִהְיְתָה אֵיכָה‎ Judg 20:3 how hath this wickedness been done ? compare 20:12 Jer 5:30; 48:19 also Neh 6:8; with לֹא‎, existence denied נ ׳לֹא‎ Zech 8:10 (|| אֵינֶ֑נָּה‎); in all the above (except Joel 2:2; Dan 12:1 & Ezek 21:12; 39:8) personal agency is clearly implied; it is expressed הַזֶּה הַדָּבָר נ הַמֶּלֶץ אֲדֹנִי ׳מֵאֵת‎ 1Kin 1:27, so of divine agency (מֵאִתִּי‎) 1 K i1 Kings 12:24 2Chr 11:4; further be attained, secured, of wages Zech 8:10 (with לֹא‎, || אֵינֶ֑נָּה‎); נִהְיָה תַּאֲוָּה‎ Prov 13:19 a desire come to pass, realized.

2 be done, finished, gone, only Daniel עָלָיו נִהְיְתָה וּשְׁנָתוֺ‎ Dan 2:1 and his sleep was finished upon him, i.e. left him (compare Aramaic 6:19); נִהְיֵיתִי‎ 8:27 I came to an end, was exhausted (si vera lectio, strike out ᵐ5‎; || נֶחֱלֵיתִי‎); נִהְיָה‎, in נִהְיָה נְהִי וְנָהָה‎ Micah 2:4, is dubious; it is done, over, the ruin is come Rob-Ges Ew Hi Ca Che L RVm;? < omit as dittograph StaZAW 1886, 122 f. compare JBL1890, 74.77.

נוב.def:
H5107. nub

[נוּב‎] verb bear fruit (poetry) (Aramaic נוֺבָא‎ fruit (rare)); —

Qal Imperfect יָנוּב‎ Psa 62:11; Prov 10:31; יְנוּבוּן‎ Psa 92:15; — only figurative, absolute of righteous under figure of tree 92:15; יָנוּב כִּי חַיִל‎ 62:11 if wealth beareth fruit; Prov 10:31 חָכְמָה יָנוּב צַדִּיק מִּי‎ beareth the fruit of wisdom.

Po`l. Imperfect יְנוֺבֵב‎ Zech 9:17, יְנ וְתִירוֺשׁ ׳בַּחוּרִים בְּתֻלוֺת דָּגָן‎ figurative for makes flourish.

נוד.def:
H5113. Nod

II. נוֺד‎ apparently proper name, of a territory ׳ארץנֿ‎ Gen 4:16 of region into which Cain wandered (compare 4:12; 4:14); ᵐ5‎ (strangely) Ναιδ; ᵑ9‎ appellative, profugus in terra, compare Symm Theod, see NeMarg. 9.

נודב.def:
H5114. Nodab

נוֺדָ֑ב‎ proper name, of a people Arab tribe according to 1Chr 5:19 (+ יְטוּר‎, נָפִישׁ‎ q. v. Gen 25:15; 1Chr 1:31); ᵐ5‎ Ναδαβαιων. (Connection with above √ quite uncertain.)

נוה.def:
ב‎

בּ ב,‎, Bêth, 2nd letter; post Biblical Hebrew = numeral 2 (and so in margin of printed MT); ב֟‎ = 2000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

I. בְּ‎,

preposition in (Moabite בּ‎, Syriac , Arabic , Ethiopic ) before tone-syllables in certain cases (Ges§ 102. 2) בָּ‎, with suffix בִּי‎; בְּךָ‎ (Ex 7:29; 2Sam 22:30; Psa 141:8 בְּכָה‎), in pause and feminine בָּךְ‎; בּוֺ‎ (once, Jer 17:24 Kt בֹּה‎), בָּהּ‎; בָּנוּ‎; בָּכֶם‎, [בָּכֶן‎]; בָּם בָּהֶם,‎ [also בָּהֵ֫מָּה‎ Exod 30:4; 36:1; Hab 1:16], בָּהֶן‎ 1Sam 31:7; Isa 38:16; Ezek 42:14 [15 times בָּהֵן‎ (FrMM 235), and thrice, Leviticus 5:22; Num 13:19; Jer 5:17, בָּהֵ֫נָּה‎]. Preposition denoting properly in, Greek ἐν, but applied in many derived and figurative significations. The senses expressed by בְּ‎ are grouped by the Rabbis in three classes, הַכְּלִי בֵּית‎ Beth vasculi, וְהַנְּגִיעָה הַדִּיבִּוּק בֵּית‎ Beth coniunctionis et viciniae, הָעֵזֶר בֵּית‎ Beth auxilii; and the same arrangement may be followed here, though the limits between the three classes are not clearly defined, and they sometimes overlap one another.

I. In:

1 strictly, of position in a place (which often is expressed more precisely by בְּתוֺךְ בְּקֶרֶב,‎), as בַּבַּיִת‎ in the house, בָּעִיר‎ in the city, בַּדּוּד‎ in the pot, בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land, etc. constantly. Hebrew idiom also says בָּהָר‎ in the mountain Exod 24:18 etc., even in cases where we could hardly avoid saying on, as 1Kin 11:7; 19:11: so בְּחֹרֵב‎ Deut 1:16 and elsewhere; הָהָר בְּראֹשׁ‎ Exod 24:17; Psa 72:16. Preceded by a verb of motion (especially עָבַר‎) בְּ‎ = through, as Gen 12:6 and Abram passed through בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land = passed through it, 13:17; 2Sam 24:2 +; in (= through) a gate, Isa 62:10; Jer 17:19; Micah 2:13. Figurative to speak בְּאָזְנֵי‎ in the ears of ...; to be good (or evil, etc.) בְּעֵינֵי‎ in the eyes of ...

2 of presence in the midst of a multitude, among, Exod 14:28 there was not left בָּהֶם‎ among them even one, Lev 26:36; 2Sam 15:31 Ahitophel בַּקֹּשְׁרִים‎ is among the conspirators, 2Kin 18:5 יְהוּדָה מַלְכֵי בְּכֹל‎. So בְּךָ‎ in thee (of Israel, collective) Deut 7:14; 15:4, 7; 18:10; 23:11; 28:54 (different from עִמָּ֑ח‎ beside thee Lev 25:35). — Specifically

a. of an individual, implying eminency among: Josh 14:15; Jer 46:18 Tabor among the mountains, 49:15; Prov 30:30; Song 1:8 בַנָּשִׁים הַיָּפָה‎ the fair one (= the fairest) among women, Lam 1:1: compare Luke 1:42. On 1Sam 17:12 see Dr.

b. hence with some verbs, when the action refers to only a part of the object, as בְּ הִכָּהַ‎ to smite among... i.e. to smite some of... (different from הִכָּה‎ with accusative); בְּ הָרַג‎ Psa 78:31; בְּ נָשָׂא‎ to bear in, i.e. to share in bearing, Num 11:17 and elsewhere; בְּ בָּנָה‎ to build in or at Zech 6:15; Neh 4:4; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ Exod 5:9; בְּ עָמֵל‎ to labour on Jonah 4:10; בְּ שָׁתָה בְּ, אָכַל‎ to eat or drink of Judg 13:16; Prov 9:5; בְּ חָלַק‎ to give a share in Job 39:17.

c. specifying the parts of which a whole consists (especially in P) Gen 7:21; 8:17; 9:10, 16; 17:23; Exod 12:19; Num 31:11, 26; Hosea 4:3.

3 with reference to the limits enclosing a space, within: Exod 20:10 בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ‎ within thy gates, Isa 56:5 בְּחוֺמוֺתַי‎ within my walls.

4 often pregn. with verbs of motion, when the movement to a place results in rest in it, into: after בָּא‎ Gen 19:8; Isa 19:23; נָתַן‎ Gen 27:17; שָׁלַח‎ to send Lev 16:22; in among Josh 23:7, 12; 1Kin 11:2. — Hosea 12:7 (an extreme case) בְּ שׁוּב‎ to return (and rest) in thy God, 1Sam 16:3 (unless לַזָּבַ֑ח‎ should be read, as 16:7). — בְּעַיִן עַיִן‎ (with) eye (looking) into eye Num 14:14; Isa 52:8; בְּפָנִים מָּנִים‎ Deut 5:4; פְ ׳עֵינֵי בְּ‎ the eyes of ... are upon, both in favourable (11:12; Psa 101:6) and hostile (Amos 9:8; Job 7:8) sense.

5 applied to time, as Gen 1:1 בְּרֵאשִׁית‎ in the beginning; 2:2 הַשְּׁבִיעִי בַּיּוֺם‎ on the seventh day; Judg 10:8 הַהִיא בַּשָּׁנָה‎ in that year; & constantly.

6 of a state or condition, whether material or mental, in which an action takes place: so often, בְּשָׁלוֺם‎ in peace Gen 15:15; בַּצָּרָה‎ in distress Psa 91:15; בְּתֻמּוֺ הָלַךְ‎ to walk in his integrity; Exod 5:19 בְּרָע‎ in evil case.

7 בְּ‎ introduces the predicate, denoting it as that in which the subject consists, or in which it shews itself (the Beth essentiae, — common in Arabic, especially with a participle or adjective and in a negative sentence: Qor 2:79 and God (appears) not as one remiss; 2:7 and they are not believers [compare French en — en honnête homme]; see WAG ii. § 56 a): namely

a. a primary predicate, Exod 18:4 the God of my fathers בְּעֶזְרִי‎ was my help, Psa 146:5; Hosea 13:9 (read בְעֶזְֶרךָ׃ מִי כִּי‎ with ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Che and others); Psa 68:5 שְׁמוֺ בְּיָהּ‎ his name consists in Yah, Job 23:13; 37:10. With the predicate in the plural (as plural of majesty) Psa 118:7 ׳י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י‎ J. is my great helper, 54:6 (see Che), Judg 11:35.

b. a secondary predicate, Exod 6:3 and I appeared unto them שַׁדָּ֑י בְּאֵל‎ as God Almighty, Num 26:53 בְּנַחֲלָה‎ as an inheritance, 34:2; Ezek 46:16; 47:14; Deut 10:22; 26:14 I have not put away therefrom בְּטָמֵא‎ as one unclean = while unclean, 28:62; Isa 40:10 יָבוֺא בְּחָזָק‎ he cometh as a strong one, Psa 35:2 (where see De) and rise up as my help, 35:16, 39:7; 55:19; Prov 3:26; Job 36:32 (De).

c. a predicate as accusative, Isa 48:10 I have refined thee בְכָ֑סֶף וְלֹא‎ but not as though silver, Ezek 20:41; Num 18:26; 36:2; Josh 13:6-7, 23:4; Ezek 45:1; 47:22 (twice in verse) (read יַמִּלוּ‎) 48:29 (see ᵐ5‎ Co) all בְּנַחֲלָה‎ (compare

b.), Psa 78:55 & allotted it נַחֲלָה בְּחֶבֶל‎ as a line of inheritance (i.e. as a measured inheritance). Isa 26:4 י עוֺלָמִים צוּר יהוה בְּיָהּ ׳כִּי‎ is different — for in Yah there is a rock of ages (compare Qor 4:7; 4:47 there is sufficiency in God as a patron).

d. in comparisons, Psa 37:20 consume away בֶּעָשָׁן‎ in the form of, as, smoke 78:33; 102:4; Job 34:36; 36:14.

II. Denoting proximity —

1 at, by (not very common): 1Sam 29:1 בָּעַיִן‎ by the spring; Ezek 10:15, 20 כְּבָר בִּנְהַר‎ by the river Chebar (1:3 עַל‎).

2 on: Gen 8:20; Num 23:2 בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ‎ on the altar; Judg 8:21 on the necks of the camels; 1Kin 2:5 and elsewhere בְּמָתְנָיו‎ on his loins; Isa 59:17 a helmet בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ on his head.

3 often with verbs of touching, approaching, taking hold of, cleaving, etc., as תָּפַשׂ תָּמַךְ, מָּגַּע, קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, נָגַע, חָשַׁק, דָּבֵק, אָחַז,‎ (see these words).

4 with words expressing or implying an act of hostility —

a. against: Gen 16:12 בּוֺ כֹּל וְיַד בַכֹּל יָדוֺ‎ his hand against all, and the hand of all against him; מְּ יַד ׳הָֽיְתָה בּ‎ Deut 13:10; 1Sam 5:9; 18:17 +? verbs (q. v.) of fighting (רִיב נִלְחַם,‎), going up to invade (עָלָה‎), being angry (אַף חָרָה אָנַף, הִתְעַבֵּר,‎), sinning or acting treacherously (כִּחֵשׁ כִּזֵּב, שִׁקֵּר, מָּשַׁע, מָעַל, מָרָה, מָרַד, בָּגַד, חָטָא,‎), testifying (הֵעִיד עָנָה,‎), mocking (הֵתֵל הִלְעִיג,‎), feeling loathing (קוּץ‎), rebuking (גָּעַר‎: properly to protest loudly), speaking (דִּבֶּר‎: Num 12:8b), etc., & even (an extreme case) Hosea 7:14 בִי יָסוּרוּ‎ they turn aside (so as to be) against me. In a weaker sense בַּקִּיר מַשְׁתִּין‎ mingens ad parietem 1Sam 25:22 and elsewhere

b. down to, upon (super with accusative), especially in such phrases as בּוֺ דָּמָיו‎ Lev 20:9 and elsewhere his blood be upon him; בְראֹשׁוֺ דָּמוֺ‎ his blood be upon his head Josh 2:19; י (הֵשִׁיב בְּראֹשׁוֺ׳שׁוּב )‎ Judges 8:57 (רָעָה‎), 1Kin 2:33 (דָּם‎), 2:44 (רָעָה‎), Psa 7:17 (עֲמָלוֺ‎); מּ דֶּרֶךְ נָתַן ׳בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ 1Kin 8:32 & often in Ezekiel, as Ezek 9:10; 11:21.

III. 1. With —

a. of accompaniment: Num 20:20 כָּבֵד בְּעַם‎ with much people, Josh 22:8; Judg 11:34; 1Kin 10:2; 2Kin 5:9; Jer 41:15; Exod 21:22 and he shall give בִּפְלִלִים‎ with arbitrators (arbitrators being employed), Isa 8:16 בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃‎ with my disciples, i.e. having them present; Exod 8:1; 8:13; Jer 11:19 בְּלַחְמוֺ עֵץ‎ a tree with its sap; 1Kin 19:19 הֶעָשָׂר בִּשְׁנֵים וְהוּא‎ and he with the 12th.

b. often of what one takes or brings with one: Gen 32:11 בְּמַקְלִי‎ with my staff I passed over Jordan, Judg 11:34; 15:1; 1Sam 1:24; Isa 7:24; Micah 6:6 and elsewhere בְּ קִדֵּם‎ to go to meet with; בְּ בָּא‎ to come with Lev 16:3; Psa 66:13; 71:16. (In Arabic this usage is developed more fully than in Hebrew, and literally to come with, literally to go away with, are used idiomatically in the sense of to bring, and to take away respectively: WAG ii. § 56 b.) Hence בְּלֹא בִּבְלִי, בְּאֶפֶס, בְּאֵין,‎ = without.

c. of concomitant (or surrounding) conditions, as בְּחִמָּזוֺן‎ with (or in) haste; בְּצֶדֶק‎ with (or in) righteousness; בִּשְׁגָגָה‎ in error; שׁוֺפָר וּבְקוֺל בִּתְרוּעָה‎ 2Sam 6:15; often in such phrases as בְּצִדְקָֽתְךָ‎ Psa 31:2 in thy righteousness; בְּחַסְדְּךָ‎ in thy mercy Exod 15:13; — בְּאָשְׁרִי‎ with my happiness! = happy am I Gen 30:13; Psa 29:4 the voice of ׳י‎ is בַּכֹּחַ‎ with power = is powerful; Exod 32:12 בְּרָעָה‎ with evil purpose; Psa 73:8 בְרָע‎ in wickedness; 90:10 בִּגְבוּרֹת‎ with strength.

2 of the instrument or means: as

a. בַּחֶרֶב‎ with the sword Exod 5:3 etc.; בְּרַגְלַיִם‎ with the feet Isa 28:3; . . . בְּיַד‎ by the hand of ... (see below יָד‎); to stone בְּאֶבֶן‎ or בָּֽאֲבָנִים‎ with stones Lev 20:2; Num 14:10 etc.; בְּ שָׁתָה‎ to drink with a cup Gen 44:5; Amos 6:6 (compare in Aramaic Dan 5:2); to cry בְּגָרוֺן‎ with the throat Isa 58:1; to burn בָּאֵשׁ‎ in or with fire (often); to slay or to perish בָּרָעָב‎ through hunger or בַּדֶּבֶר‎ through pestilence Exod 16:3; Jer 21:9 + often (compare Job 27:15 יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ בַּמָּוֶת‎); to save with or by Judg 7:7; 1Sam 14:6.

b. idiomatic, with certain verbs, as בְּ שָׁחַק‎ to play with Job 40:29; בְּ עָבַד‎ to labour with a person (as with an instrument), i.e. to use him as a slave Exod 1:14; Jer 22:13; 27:7 and elsewhere; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ 18:23; Neh 9:24; Dan 11:7; Est 1:15; 2:11; 3:11; 6:6; & perhaps בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ (of God) to speak with one Num 12:2, 8a and elsewhere (see Ew§ 217 f. (3); DrSm ii. 23, 2). Further ביהוה הִתְנַבֵּא בַּבַּעַל,‎ to prophesy with or by ׳י‎ or Baal, ׳י‎ or Baal being the inspirer; דָּרַשׁ בְּ, שָׁאַל‎ to inquire or ask by means of a god (or oracle).

c. ביהוה‎ through ׳י‎ (= by His aid) in many connections, as Psa 18:30; 44:6; 56:5; 56:11; Psalm 60:14; Isa 26:13; 45:25; Hosea 1:7; Zech 10:12; with passive verbs Deut 33:29; Isa 45:17 (to be saved): and even of the immediate cause Num 36:2 to be commanded ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎, Gen 9:6 בָּאָדָם‎ by man shall his blood be shed (both unusual), Hosea 14:4.

d. allied is the use of בְּ‎ in such phrases as to bless, swear, speak, prophesy, etc., בְּשֵׁם‎ in the name of ... (i.e. the name being used or appealed to in the act) Deut 6:13; Jer 11:21, etc. (so to swear ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎ Josh 2:12 etc.,בִּימִינוֺ‎ Isa 62:8; to bless בְּךָ‎ with thee Gen 48:20, to swear with me Psa 102:9, i.e. using my name in oath, Jer 29:22); almost = in the authority and power of 1Sam 17:45; 25:5; 1Kin 21:8; Micah 4:5; Zech 10:12; Psa 20:6; 44:6; 89:25.

e. בַּמָּה‎ or בַּמֶּה‎ by means of what? how? Gen 15:8; Judg 6:15; 16:5-6, 10; 1Kin 22:21; Mal 2:17. בְּזֹאת‎ by means of this Gen 42:15, 33. Exod 7:17; Num 16:28; with this = on this condition Gen 34:15, 22; 1Sam 11:2; Isa 27:9.

3 of cost or price (the Beth pretii), the price, whether given or received, being treated as the instrumental means by which the act is accomplished, with, for, at the cost of: thus regularly

a. with שָׂכַר‎ hire Gen 30:16, מָּדָה‎ redeem Exod 34:20, אֵרֵשׂ‎ betroth 2Sam 3:14, קָנָה‎ buy 24:24; 1Kin 2:23 בְּנַפְשׁוֺ‎ at the cost of his life hath A. spoken this word, 2Sam 23:17 who went בְּנַפְשׂוֺתָם‎ at peril of their lives, Prov 7:23; Lam 5:9; Josh 6:26 יְיַסְּדֶנָּה בִּבְכֹרוֺ‎ at the price of his firstborn shall he lay its foundations, 1Chr 12:19 בְּרָאשֵׁינוּ‎ to the jeopardy of our heads he will fall away, etc.

b. with מָכַר‎ sell Deut 21:14; עָבַד‎ serve Gen 29:18, 20; Hosea 12:13; הֵמִיר‎ exchange Lev 27:10; Hosea 4:7 their glory I will exchange for ignominy, Psa 106:20; בְּנֶשֶׁךְ נָתַן‎ to give for interest Lev 25:37; Psa 15:5; in other connections Gen 23:9; 47:16f.; Isa 45:13; Lam 1:11; Cant 8:7; 8:11; Deut 19:21 בְּעַיִן עַיִן בְּנֶפֶשׁ נֶפֶשׁ‎ life for life, eye for eye; Isa 2:22 הוּא נֶחְשָׁב בַּמֶּה‎ at what is he to be accounted? 7:23 a thousand vines כָּ֑סֶף בְּאֶלֶף‎ at a thousand (shekels of) silver. — Hence (perhaps) the idiomatic usages בְשָׁנָה שָׁנָה‎ year for year, one year like another, annually Deut 15:20 and elsewhere; בְּיוֺם יוֺם‎ (late), בְּיוֺם כְּיוֺם‎ 1Sam 18:10; בְּפַעַם כְּפַעַם‎ (see מַּעַם יוֺם,‎); בְּחֹדֶשׁ חֹדֶשׁ‎ 1Chr 27:1.

4 rather peculiarly, in certain cases where the object of an action may be treated as the instrument by which it is accomplished: as בְּראֹשׁ הֵנַיעַ‎ to shake with the head Jer 18:6; Job 16:4 (as well as ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ‎ Psa 22:8); to open with the mouth Job 16:10, with the lips Psa 22:8; to gnash with the teeth Job 16:9 (to gnash the teeth Psa 35:16); to wink with the eye Prov 6:13 (to wink the eye, ib. 10:10); בְּקוֺל נָתַן‎ to utter with the voice Psa 46:7; 68:34; Jer 12:8 (but קוֺל נָתַן‎ is more common); to stretch out with the hand Lam 1:17; בַּמַּטֶּה הֵרִים‎ (unusual) Exod 7:20. So בְּשֵׁם קָרָא‎ to call with the name — in different senses, according to the context, namely, to proclaim 33:19; 34:5; Isa 44:5; Psa 49:12; to invoke Gen 4:26; 12:8; 1Kin 18:24-26 Isa 12:4; to name honourably 43:1; 45:3. compare Ew§ 282 d Ges§ 119. 3 b R. WAG ii. § 56 b β DeJob 31:12; Prov 20:30.

5 with a causal force, through, on account of: Gen 18:28 בַּחֲמִשָּׁה הֲתַשְׁחִית‎ wilt thou destroy on account of five the whole city? Lev 26:39; Num 16:26; Deut 9:4-5, 24:16 יוּמָֽתוּ׃ בְּחֶטְאוֺ אִישׁ‎ they shall be put to death, each because of his own sin (compare Jer 31:30; Ezek 3:18, see 18:17) 2Sam 3:27; 14:7 (compare Jonah 1:14) Isa 7:4 (|| מִן‎) 28:7 (|| מִן‎) 50:1; 53:5; 57:17; Jer 51:46; Psa 5:8; 5:11; 6:8 (|| מִן‎) 31:10; 32:3; 42:10; 90:9; 94:23. So in בִּגְלַל בַּאֲשֶׁר,‎ (see גָּלָל אֲשֶׁר,‎), & (sometimes) in בִּדְבַר‎ at, through, the word of ....

6 of the material with which a work is wrought, both absolute בַזָּהָב עָשָׁה‎ to work with gold Exod 31:4; 1Kin 7:14; and to make a thing with (in our idiom, of) gold Exod 38:8; Ezek 7:20; 1Kin 15:22 (בָּנָה‎). Without a verb Lev 13:52; 2Chr 9:18.

7 with for although, in spite of (compare German bei alle dem): Lev 26:27; Num 14:11 הָאֹתוֺת בְּכֹל‎ in spite of all the signs that I have wrought, Deut 1:32; Isa 47:9; Psa 27:3; especially in the phrase בְּכָלזֿאת‎ for all this Isa 5:25; 9:11; 9:16; 9:20; 10:4; Psa 78:32 and elsewhere (compare in Arabic Qor 9:25.)

8 of a standard of measurement or computation, with, by: Exod 12:4 נְפָשֹׁת בְּמִכְסַת‎ by the computation of souls; Leviticus 5:25 and elsewhere בְּעֶרְכְּךָ‎ by thy reckoning; Ezek 4:10; בְּמִסְמָּר‎ by number Deut 25:2 +; . . . בְּמִסְמַּר‎ by the number of ... Lev 25:15, 50; Num 1:2, etc.; הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּשֶׁקֶל‎ Exod 30:13 and elsewhere (in P); בָּאַמָּה‎ often (see אַמָּה‎); Deut 3:11 אִישׁ בְּאַמַּת‎ by the cubit of a man; 2Sam 14:26 הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּאֶבֶן‎. Of a model, Gen 1:26 בְּצַלְמֵנוּ‎ in our image, 5:1, 3; Exod 25:40; בְּדֶרֶךְ‎ with the way (= in the manner) of ... Isa 10:24, 26; Amos 4:10.

IV. בְּ‎ is used also with certain classes of verbs, though the explanation of its use may be sometimes doubtful: namely

a. with verbs of taking refuge, trusting, relying, as נִשְׁעַן חָסָה, בָּטַח, הֶאֱמִין,‎.

b. with verbs of ruling, governing, restraining, as שָׁלַט רָדָה, עָצַר, נָגַשׂ, מָשַׁל, מָלַךְ,‎.

c. with verbs of rejoicing, feeling pleasure or satisfaction, etc., as שָׂבַע רָצָה, חָפֵץ, שָׂמֵחַ, שׂוּשׂ, עָלַץ, גִּיל,‎ (but with this verb מִן‎ is more common). [Probably a case of

III. 5.]

d. with verbs expressive of sensible perception, to denote the pleasurable or attentive exercise of the faculty concerned, as בְּ שָׁמַע‎ to listen to, חָזָה רָאָה, בְּ, הִבִּיט‎, to look upon, בְּ הֵרִיחַ‎ to smell at (see these words).

e. occasionally also with verbs of speaking, thinking, mentioning, knowing, to denote the object of the action, as בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ to speak about Deut 6:7; Psa 87:3 and elsewhere (see below דִּבֶּר‎); שִׂיחַ הָגָה, בְּ, הִלֵּל‎ 44:9; 63:7; 69:13; יָדַע‎ Jer 38:24; זָכַר‎ once 3:16, הִזְכִּיר‎ often; Psa 71:6 תְהִלָּתִי בְּךָ‎ of thee is my praise.

V. Followed by an infinitive with, בְּ‎ forms a periphrasis for the gerund, though in English it is commonly to be rendered by a verb and conjunction, namely: —

1 as a temporal conjunction, as Gen 2:4 בְּהִבָּֽרְאָם‎ in their being created = when they were created, 4:8 בִּהְיוֺתָם‎ in their being (= when they were) in the field; and constantly. Sometimes it has in appearance the force of after that, as 33:18; Exod 3:12; 13:17; but as a rule this is really due to the action denoted by the infinitive being treated as extending over a period within which the action of the principal verb takes place: so especially in the phrase מִמִּצְרַיִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאת‎, even of events at the close of the 40 years, Deut 4:45; 23:5; Josh 5:4, the whole period being treated as that in which Egypt was left (compare 2Kin 2:1, where the time included is future). Cases, however, occur in which this explanation will hardly apply, as Deut 27:4; 24:12.

2 as a causal conjunction (compare above

III. 5), as Gen 19:16 עָלָיו י ׳בְּחֶמְלַת‎ through J.'s having compassion upon him, Exod 16:7; 33:16; 34:29; Deut 1:27 י ׳בְּשִׂנְאַת אֹתָנוּ‎ through J.'s hating us, etc. (9:28 similarly מִן‎), 1Kin 18:18 (= in that ye have ...) Ezek 9:8; 43:8; 44:7; 2Chr 28:6.

3 as a concessive conjunction, when = though: Isa 1:15; Psa 46:3 אָ֑רֶץ בְּהָמִיר‎ though the earth do change.

Note. — Exod 10:12 בָּאַרְבֶּה‎ can only be rendered 'with the locusts,' the locusts being conceived as implicit in Moses' uplifted hand: but probably לָאַרְבֶּה‎ should be read. Thrice in late Hebrew בְּ‎ is used peculiarly: 1Chr 7:23 for with misfortune was it in his house (בְּרָעָה‎ chosen for the purpose of explaining בְּרִיעָה‎); 9:33 בַּמְּלָאכָה עֲלֵיהֶם‎ it devolved upon them with the work; Ezra 3:3 for with terror (was it) upon them from the peoples of the countries (the sentence without a verb as often in Chronicles: DrIntr. 504 f.): compare 8:34. compare Ew§ 295 f.

נוף.def:
ב‎

בּ ב,‎, Bêth, 2nd letter; post Biblical Hebrew = numeral 2 (and so in margin of printed MT); ב֟‎ = 2000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

I. בְּ‎,

preposition in (Moabite בּ‎, Syriac , Arabic , Ethiopic ) before tone-syllables in certain cases (Ges§ 102. 2) בָּ‎, with suffix בִּי‎; בְּךָ‎ (Ex 7:29; 2Sam 22:30; Psa 141:8 בְּכָה‎), in pause and feminine בָּךְ‎; בּוֺ‎ (once, Jer 17:24 Kt בֹּה‎), בָּהּ‎; בָּנוּ‎; בָּכֶם‎, [בָּכֶן‎]; בָּם בָּהֶם,‎ [also בָּהֵ֫מָּה‎ Exod 30:4; 36:1; Hab 1:16], בָּהֶן‎ 1Sam 31:7; Isa 38:16; Ezek 42:14 [15 times בָּהֵן‎ (FrMM 235), and thrice, Leviticus 5:22; Num 13:19; Jer 5:17, בָּהֵ֫נָּה‎]. Preposition denoting properly in, Greek ἐν, but applied in many derived and figurative significations. The senses expressed by בְּ‎ are grouped by the Rabbis in three classes, הַכְּלִי בֵּית‎ Beth vasculi, וְהַנְּגִיעָה הַדִּיבִּוּק בֵּית‎ Beth coniunctionis et viciniae, הָעֵזֶר בֵּית‎ Beth auxilii; and the same arrangement may be followed here, though the limits between the three classes are not clearly defined, and they sometimes overlap one another.

I. In:

1 strictly, of position in a place (which often is expressed more precisely by בְּתוֺךְ בְּקֶרֶב,‎), as בַּבַּיִת‎ in the house, בָּעִיר‎ in the city, בַּדּוּד‎ in the pot, בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land, etc. constantly. Hebrew idiom also says בָּהָר‎ in the mountain Exod 24:18 etc., even in cases where we could hardly avoid saying on, as 1Kin 11:7; 19:11: so בְּחֹרֵב‎ Deut 1:16 and elsewhere; הָהָר בְּראֹשׁ‎ Exod 24:17; Psa 72:16. Preceded by a verb of motion (especially עָבַר‎) בְּ‎ = through, as Gen 12:6 and Abram passed through בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land = passed through it, 13:17; 2Sam 24:2 +; in (= through) a gate, Isa 62:10; Jer 17:19; Micah 2:13. Figurative to speak בְּאָזְנֵי‎ in the ears of ...; to be good (or evil, etc.) בְּעֵינֵי‎ in the eyes of ...

2 of presence in the midst of a multitude, among, Exod 14:28 there was not left בָּהֶם‎ among them even one, Lev 26:36; 2Sam 15:31 Ahitophel בַּקֹּשְׁרִים‎ is among the conspirators, 2Kin 18:5 יְהוּדָה מַלְכֵי בְּכֹל‎. So בְּךָ‎ in thee (of Israel, collective) Deut 7:14; 15:4, 7; 18:10; 23:11; 28:54 (different from עִמָּ֑ח‎ beside thee Lev 25:35). — Specifically

a. of an individual, implying eminency among: Josh 14:15; Jer 46:18 Tabor among the mountains, 49:15; Prov 30:30; Song 1:8 בַנָּשִׁים הַיָּפָה‎ the fair one (= the fairest) among women, Lam 1:1: compare Luke 1:42. On 1Sam 17:12 see Dr.

b. hence with some verbs, when the action refers to only a part of the object, as בְּ הִכָּהַ‎ to smite among... i.e. to smite some of... (different from הִכָּה‎ with accusative); בְּ הָרַג‎ Psa 78:31; בְּ נָשָׂא‎ to bear in, i.e. to share in bearing, Num 11:17 and elsewhere; בְּ בָּנָה‎ to build in or at Zech 6:15; Neh 4:4; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ Exod 5:9; בְּ עָמֵל‎ to labour on Jonah 4:10; בְּ שָׁתָה בְּ, אָכַל‎ to eat or drink of Judg 13:16; Prov 9:5; בְּ חָלַק‎ to give a share in Job 39:17.

c. specifying the parts of which a whole consists (especially in P) Gen 7:21; 8:17; 9:10, 16; 17:23; Exod 12:19; Num 31:11, 26; Hosea 4:3.

3 with reference to the limits enclosing a space, within: Exod 20:10 בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ‎ within thy gates, Isa 56:5 בְּחוֺמוֺתַי‎ within my walls.

4 often pregn. with verbs of motion, when the movement to a place results in rest in it, into: after בָּא‎ Gen 19:8; Isa 19:23; נָתַן‎ Gen 27:17; שָׁלַח‎ to send Lev 16:22; in among Josh 23:7, 12; 1Kin 11:2. — Hosea 12:7 (an extreme case) בְּ שׁוּב‎ to return (and rest) in thy God, 1Sam 16:3 (unless לַזָּבַ֑ח‎ should be read, as 16:7). — בְּעַיִן עַיִן‎ (with) eye (looking) into eye Num 14:14; Isa 52:8; בְּפָנִים מָּנִים‎ Deut 5:4; פְ ׳עֵינֵי בְּ‎ the eyes of ... are upon, both in favourable (11:12; Psa 101:6) and hostile (Amos 9:8; Job 7:8) sense.

5 applied to time, as Gen 1:1 בְּרֵאשִׁית‎ in the beginning; 2:2 הַשְּׁבִיעִי בַּיּוֺם‎ on the seventh day; Judg 10:8 הַהִיא בַּשָּׁנָה‎ in that year; & constantly.

6 of a state or condition, whether material or mental, in which an action takes place: so often, בְּשָׁלוֺם‎ in peace Gen 15:15; בַּצָּרָה‎ in distress Psa 91:15; בְּתֻמּוֺ הָלַךְ‎ to walk in his integrity; Exod 5:19 בְּרָע‎ in evil case.

7 בְּ‎ introduces the predicate, denoting it as that in which the subject consists, or in which it shews itself (the Beth essentiae, — common in Arabic, especially with a participle or adjective and in a negative sentence: Qor 2:79 and God (appears) not as one remiss; 2:7 and they are not believers [compare French en — en honnête homme]; see WAG ii. § 56 a): namely

a. a primary predicate, Exod 18:4 the God of my fathers בְּעֶזְרִי‎ was my help, Psa 146:5; Hosea 13:9 (read בְעֶזְֶרךָ׃ מִי כִּי‎ with ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Che and others); Psa 68:5 שְׁמוֺ בְּיָהּ‎ his name consists in Yah, Job 23:13; 37:10. With the predicate in the plural (as plural of majesty) Psa 118:7 ׳י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י‎ J. is my great helper, 54:6 (see Che), Judg 11:35.

b. a secondary predicate, Exod 6:3 and I appeared unto them שַׁדָּ֑י בְּאֵל‎ as God Almighty, Num 26:53 בְּנַחֲלָה‎ as an inheritance, 34:2; Ezek 46:16; 47:14; Deut 10:22; 26:14 I have not put away therefrom בְּטָמֵא‎ as one unclean = while unclean, 28:62; Isa 40:10 יָבוֺא בְּחָזָק‎ he cometh as a strong one, Psa 35:2 (where see De) and rise up as my help, 35:16, 39:7; 55:19; Prov 3:26; Job 36:32 (De).

c. a predicate as accusative, Isa 48:10 I have refined thee בְכָ֑סֶף וְלֹא‎ but not as though silver, Ezek 20:41; Num 18:26; 36:2; Josh 13:6-7, 23:4; Ezek 45:1; 47:22 (twice in verse) (read יַמִּלוּ‎) 48:29 (see ᵐ5‎ Co) all בְּנַחֲלָה‎ (compare

b.), Psa 78:55 & allotted it נַחֲלָה בְּחֶבֶל‎ as a line of inheritance (i.e. as a measured inheritance). Isa 26:4 י עוֺלָמִים צוּר יהוה בְּיָהּ ׳כִּי‎ is different — for in Yah there is a rock of ages (compare Qor 4:7; 4:47 there is sufficiency in God as a patron).

d. in comparisons, Psa 37:20 consume away בֶּעָשָׁן‎ in the form of, as, smoke 78:33; 102:4; Job 34:36; 36:14.

II. Denoting proximity —

1 at, by (not very common): 1Sam 29:1 בָּעַיִן‎ by the spring; Ezek 10:15, 20 כְּבָר בִּנְהַר‎ by the river Chebar (1:3 עַל‎).

2 on: Gen 8:20; Num 23:2 בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ‎ on the altar; Judg 8:21 on the necks of the camels; 1Kin 2:5 and elsewhere בְּמָתְנָיו‎ on his loins; Isa 59:17 a helmet בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ on his head.

3 often with verbs of touching, approaching, taking hold of, cleaving, etc., as תָּפַשׂ תָּמַךְ, מָּגַּע, קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, נָגַע, חָשַׁק, דָּבֵק, אָחַז,‎ (see these words).

4 with words expressing or implying an act of hostility —

a. against: Gen 16:12 בּוֺ כֹּל וְיַד בַכֹּל יָדוֺ‎ his hand against all, and the hand of all against him; מְּ יַד ׳הָֽיְתָה בּ‎ Deut 13:10; 1Sam 5:9; 18:17 +? verbs (q. v.) of fighting (רִיב נִלְחַם,‎), going up to invade (עָלָה‎), being angry (אַף חָרָה אָנַף, הִתְעַבֵּר,‎), sinning or acting treacherously (כִּחֵשׁ כִּזֵּב, שִׁקֵּר, מָּשַׁע, מָעַל, מָרָה, מָרַד, בָּגַד, חָטָא,‎), testifying (הֵעִיד עָנָה,‎), mocking (הֵתֵל הִלְעִיג,‎), feeling loathing (קוּץ‎), rebuking (גָּעַר‎: properly to protest loudly), speaking (דִּבֶּר‎: Num 12:8b), etc., & even (an extreme case) Hosea 7:14 בִי יָסוּרוּ‎ they turn aside (so as to be) against me. In a weaker sense בַּקִּיר מַשְׁתִּין‎ mingens ad parietem 1Sam 25:22 and elsewhere

b. down to, upon (super with accusative), especially in such phrases as בּוֺ דָּמָיו‎ Lev 20:9 and elsewhere his blood be upon him; בְראֹשׁוֺ דָּמוֺ‎ his blood be upon his head Josh 2:19; י (הֵשִׁיב בְּראֹשׁוֺ׳שׁוּב )‎ Judges 8:57 (רָעָה‎), 1Kin 2:33 (דָּם‎), 2:44 (רָעָה‎), Psa 7:17 (עֲמָלוֺ‎); מּ דֶּרֶךְ נָתַן ׳בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ 1Kin 8:32 & often in Ezekiel, as Ezek 9:10; 11:21.

III. 1. With —

a. of accompaniment: Num 20:20 כָּבֵד בְּעַם‎ with much people, Josh 22:8; Judg 11:34; 1Kin 10:2; 2Kin 5:9; Jer 41:15; Exod 21:22 and he shall give בִּפְלִלִים‎ with arbitrators (arbitrators being employed), Isa 8:16 בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃‎ with my disciples, i.e. having them present; Exod 8:1; 8:13; Jer 11:19 בְּלַחְמוֺ עֵץ‎ a tree with its sap; 1Kin 19:19 הֶעָשָׂר בִּשְׁנֵים וְהוּא‎ and he with the 12th.

b. often of what one takes or brings with one: Gen 32:11 בְּמַקְלִי‎ with my staff I passed over Jordan, Judg 11:34; 15:1; 1Sam 1:24; Isa 7:24; Micah 6:6 and elsewhere בְּ קִדֵּם‎ to go to meet with; בְּ בָּא‎ to come with Lev 16:3; Psa 66:13; 71:16. (In Arabic this usage is developed more fully than in Hebrew, and literally to come with, literally to go away with, are used idiomatically in the sense of to bring, and to take away respectively: WAG ii. § 56 b.) Hence בְּלֹא בִּבְלִי, בְּאֶפֶס, בְּאֵין,‎ = without.

c. of concomitant (or surrounding) conditions, as בְּחִמָּזוֺן‎ with (or in) haste; בְּצֶדֶק‎ with (or in) righteousness; בִּשְׁגָגָה‎ in error; שׁוֺפָר וּבְקוֺל בִּתְרוּעָה‎ 2Sam 6:15; often in such phrases as בְּצִדְקָֽתְךָ‎ Psa 31:2 in thy righteousness; בְּחַסְדְּךָ‎ in thy mercy Exod 15:13; — בְּאָשְׁרִי‎ with my happiness! = happy am I Gen 30:13; Psa 29:4 the voice of ׳י‎ is בַּכֹּחַ‎ with power = is powerful; Exod 32:12 בְּרָעָה‎ with evil purpose; Psa 73:8 בְרָע‎ in wickedness; 90:10 בִּגְבוּרֹת‎ with strength.

2 of the instrument or means: as

a. בַּחֶרֶב‎ with the sword Exod 5:3 etc.; בְּרַגְלַיִם‎ with the feet Isa 28:3; . . . בְּיַד‎ by the hand of ... (see below יָד‎); to stone בְּאֶבֶן‎ or בָּֽאֲבָנִים‎ with stones Lev 20:2; Num 14:10 etc.; בְּ שָׁתָה‎ to drink with a cup Gen 44:5; Amos 6:6 (compare in Aramaic Dan 5:2); to cry בְּגָרוֺן‎ with the throat Isa 58:1; to burn בָּאֵשׁ‎ in or with fire (often); to slay or to perish בָּרָעָב‎ through hunger or בַּדֶּבֶר‎ through pestilence Exod 16:3; Jer 21:9 + often (compare Job 27:15 יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ בַּמָּוֶת‎); to save with or by Judg 7:7; 1Sam 14:6.

b. idiomatic, with certain verbs, as בְּ שָׁחַק‎ to play with Job 40:29; בְּ עָבַד‎ to labour with a person (as with an instrument), i.e. to use him as a slave Exod 1:14; Jer 22:13; 27:7 and elsewhere; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ 18:23; Neh 9:24; Dan 11:7; Est 1:15; 2:11; 3:11; 6:6; & perhaps בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ (of God) to speak with one Num 12:2, 8a and elsewhere (see Ew§ 217 f. (3); DrSm ii. 23, 2). Further ביהוה הִתְנַבֵּא בַּבַּעַל,‎ to prophesy with or by ׳י‎ or Baal, ׳י‎ or Baal being the inspirer; דָּרַשׁ בְּ, שָׁאַל‎ to inquire or ask by means of a god (or oracle).

c. ביהוה‎ through ׳י‎ (= by His aid) in many connections, as Psa 18:30; 44:6; 56:5; 56:11; Psalm 60:14; Isa 26:13; 45:25; Hosea 1:7; Zech 10:12; with passive verbs Deut 33:29; Isa 45:17 (to be saved): and even of the immediate cause Num 36:2 to be commanded ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎, Gen 9:6 בָּאָדָם‎ by man shall his blood be shed (both unusual), Hosea 14:4.

d. allied is the use of בְּ‎ in such phrases as to bless, swear, speak, prophesy, etc., בְּשֵׁם‎ in the name of ... (i.e. the name being used or appealed to in the act) Deut 6:13; Jer 11:21, etc. (so to swear ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎ Josh 2:12 etc.,בִּימִינוֺ‎ Isa 62:8; to bless בְּךָ‎ with thee Gen 48:20, to swear with me Psa 102:9, i.e. using my name in oath, Jer 29:22); almost = in the authority and power of 1Sam 17:45; 25:5; 1Kin 21:8; Micah 4:5; Zech 10:12; Psa 20:6; 44:6; 89:25.

e. בַּמָּה‎ or בַּמֶּה‎ by means of what? how? Gen 15:8; Judg 6:15; 16:5-6, 10; 1Kin 22:21; Mal 2:17. בְּזֹאת‎ by means of this Gen 42:15, 33. Exod 7:17; Num 16:28; with this = on this condition Gen 34:15, 22; 1Sam 11:2; Isa 27:9.

3 of cost or price (the Beth pretii), the price, whether given or received, being treated as the instrumental means by which the act is accomplished, with, for, at the cost of: thus regularly

a. with שָׂכַר‎ hire Gen 30:16, מָּדָה‎ redeem Exod 34:20, אֵרֵשׂ‎ betroth 2Sam 3:14, קָנָה‎ buy 24:24; 1Kin 2:23 בְּנַפְשׁוֺ‎ at the cost of his life hath A. spoken this word, 2Sam 23:17 who went בְּנַפְשׂוֺתָם‎ at peril of their lives, Prov 7:23; Lam 5:9; Josh 6:26 יְיַסְּדֶנָּה בִּבְכֹרוֺ‎ at the price of his firstborn shall he lay its foundations, 1Chr 12:19 בְּרָאשֵׁינוּ‎ to the jeopardy of our heads he will fall away, etc.

b. with מָכַר‎ sell Deut 21:14; עָבַד‎ serve Gen 29:18, 20; Hosea 12:13; הֵמִיר‎ exchange Lev 27:10; Hosea 4:7 their glory I will exchange for ignominy, Psa 106:20; בְּנֶשֶׁךְ נָתַן‎ to give for interest Lev 25:37; Psa 15:5; in other connections Gen 23:9; 47:16f.; Isa 45:13; Lam 1:11; Cant 8:7; 8:11; Deut 19:21 בְּעַיִן עַיִן בְּנֶפֶשׁ נֶפֶשׁ‎ life for life, eye for eye; Isa 2:22 הוּא נֶחְשָׁב בַּמֶּה‎ at what is he to be accounted? 7:23 a thousand vines כָּ֑סֶף בְּאֶלֶף‎ at a thousand (shekels of) silver. — Hence (perhaps) the idiomatic usages בְשָׁנָה שָׁנָה‎ year for year, one year like another, annually Deut 15:20 and elsewhere; בְּיוֺם יוֺם‎ (late), בְּיוֺם כְּיוֺם‎ 1Sam 18:10; בְּפַעַם כְּפַעַם‎ (see מַּעַם יוֺם,‎); בְּחֹדֶשׁ חֹדֶשׁ‎ 1Chr 27:1.

4 rather peculiarly, in certain cases where the object of an action may be treated as the instrument by which it is accomplished: as בְּראֹשׁ הֵנַיעַ‎ to shake with the head Jer 18:6; Job 16:4 (as well as ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ‎ Psa 22:8); to open with the mouth Job 16:10, with the lips Psa 22:8; to gnash with the teeth Job 16:9 (to gnash the teeth Psa 35:16); to wink with the eye Prov 6:13 (to wink the eye, ib. 10:10); בְּקוֺל נָתַן‎ to utter with the voice Psa 46:7; 68:34; Jer 12:8 (but קוֺל נָתַן‎ is more common); to stretch out with the hand Lam 1:17; בַּמַּטֶּה הֵרִים‎ (unusual) Exod 7:20. So בְּשֵׁם קָרָא‎ to call with the name — in different senses, according to the context, namely, to proclaim 33:19; 34:5; Isa 44:5; Psa 49:12; to invoke Gen 4:26; 12:8; 1Kin 18:24-26 Isa 12:4; to name honourably 43:1; 45:3. compare Ew§ 282 d Ges§ 119. 3 b R. WAG ii. § 56 b β DeJob 31:12; Prov 20:30.

5 with a causal force, through, on account of: Gen 18:28 בַּחֲמִשָּׁה הֲתַשְׁחִית‎ wilt thou destroy on account of five the whole city? Lev 26:39; Num 16:26; Deut 9:4-5, 24:16 יוּמָֽתוּ׃ בְּחֶטְאוֺ אִישׁ‎ they shall be put to death, each because of his own sin (compare Jer 31:30; Ezek 3:18, see 18:17) 2Sam 3:27; 14:7 (compare Jonah 1:14) Isa 7:4 (|| מִן‎) 28:7 (|| מִן‎) 50:1; 53:5; 57:17; Jer 51:46; Psa 5:8; 5:11; 6:8 (|| מִן‎) 31:10; 32:3; 42:10; 90:9; 94:23. So in בִּגְלַל בַּאֲשֶׁר,‎ (see גָּלָל אֲשֶׁר,‎), & (sometimes) in בִּדְבַר‎ at, through, the word of ....

6 of the material with which a work is wrought, both absolute בַזָּהָב עָשָׁה‎ to work with gold Exod 31:4; 1Kin 7:14; and to make a thing with (in our idiom, of) gold Exod 38:8; Ezek 7:20; 1Kin 15:22 (בָּנָה‎). Without a verb Lev 13:52; 2Chr 9:18.

7 with for although, in spite of (compare German bei alle dem): Lev 26:27; Num 14:11 הָאֹתוֺת בְּכֹל‎ in spite of all the signs that I have wrought, Deut 1:32; Isa 47:9; Psa 27:3; especially in the phrase בְּכָלזֿאת‎ for all this Isa 5:25; 9:11; 9:16; 9:20; 10:4; Psa 78:32 and elsewhere (compare in Arabic Qor 9:25.)

8 of a standard of measurement or computation, with, by: Exod 12:4 נְפָשֹׁת בְּמִכְסַת‎ by the computation of souls; Leviticus 5:25 and elsewhere בְּעֶרְכְּךָ‎ by thy reckoning; Ezek 4:10; בְּמִסְמָּר‎ by number Deut 25:2 +; . . . בְּמִסְמַּר‎ by the number of ... Lev 25:15, 50; Num 1:2, etc.; הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּשֶׁקֶל‎ Exod 30:13 and elsewhere (in P); בָּאַמָּה‎ often (see אַמָּה‎); Deut 3:11 אִישׁ בְּאַמַּת‎ by the cubit of a man; 2Sam 14:26 הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּאֶבֶן‎. Of a model, Gen 1:26 בְּצַלְמֵנוּ‎ in our image, 5:1, 3; Exod 25:40; בְּדֶרֶךְ‎ with the way (= in the manner) of ... Isa 10:24, 26; Amos 4:10.

IV. בְּ‎ is used also with certain classes of verbs, though the explanation of its use may be sometimes doubtful: namely

a. with verbs of taking refuge, trusting, relying, as נִשְׁעַן חָסָה, בָּטַח, הֶאֱמִין,‎.

b. with verbs of ruling, governing, restraining, as שָׁלַט רָדָה, עָצַר, נָגַשׂ, מָשַׁל, מָלַךְ,‎.

c. with verbs of rejoicing, feeling pleasure or satisfaction, etc., as שָׂבַע רָצָה, חָפֵץ, שָׂמֵחַ, שׂוּשׂ, עָלַץ, גִּיל,‎ (but with this verb מִן‎ is more common). [Probably a case of

III. 5.]

d. with verbs expressive of sensible perception, to denote the pleasurable or attentive exercise of the faculty concerned, as בְּ שָׁמַע‎ to listen to, חָזָה רָאָה, בְּ, הִבִּיט‎, to look upon, בְּ הֵרִיחַ‎ to smell at (see these words).

e. occasionally also with verbs of speaking, thinking, mentioning, knowing, to denote the object of the action, as בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ to speak about Deut 6:7; Psa 87:3 and elsewhere (see below דִּבֶּר‎); שִׂיחַ הָגָה, בְּ, הִלֵּל‎ 44:9; 63:7; 69:13; יָדַע‎ Jer 38:24; זָכַר‎ once 3:16, הִזְכִּיר‎ often; Psa 71:6 תְהִלָּתִי בְּךָ‎ of thee is my praise.

V. Followed by an infinitive with, בְּ‎ forms a periphrasis for the gerund, though in English it is commonly to be rendered by a verb and conjunction, namely: —

1 as a temporal conjunction, as Gen 2:4 בְּהִבָּֽרְאָם‎ in their being created = when they were created, 4:8 בִּהְיוֺתָם‎ in their being (= when they were) in the field; and constantly. Sometimes it has in appearance the force of after that, as 33:18; Exod 3:12; 13:17; but as a rule this is really due to the action denoted by the infinitive being treated as extending over a period within which the action of the principal verb takes place: so especially in the phrase מִמִּצְרַיִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאת‎, even of events at the close of the 40 years, Deut 4:45; 23:5; Josh 5:4, the whole period being treated as that in which Egypt was left (compare 2Kin 2:1, where the time included is future). Cases, however, occur in which this explanation will hardly apply, as Deut 27:4; 24:12.

2 as a causal conjunction (compare above

III. 5), as Gen 19:16 עָלָיו י ׳בְּחֶמְלַת‎ through J.'s having compassion upon him, Exod 16:7; 33:16; 34:29; Deut 1:27 י ׳בְּשִׂנְאַת אֹתָנוּ‎ through J.'s hating us, etc. (9:28 similarly מִן‎), 1Kin 18:18 (= in that ye have ...) Ezek 9:8; 43:8; 44:7; 2Chr 28:6.

3 as a concessive conjunction, when = though: Isa 1:15; Psa 46:3 אָ֑רֶץ בְּהָמִיר‎ though the earth do change.

Note. — Exod 10:12 בָּאַרְבֶּה‎ can only be rendered 'with the locusts,' the locusts being conceived as implicit in Moses' uplifted hand: but probably לָאַרְבֶּה‎ should be read. Thrice in late Hebrew בְּ‎ is used peculiarly: 1Chr 7:23 for with misfortune was it in his house (בְּרָעָה‎ chosen for the purpose of explaining בְּרִיעָה‎); 9:33 בַּמְּלָאכָה עֲלֵיהֶם‎ it devolved upon them with the work; Ezra 3:3 for with terror (was it) upon them from the peoples of the countries (the sentence without a verb as often in Chronicles: DrIntr. 504 f.): compare 8:34. compare Ew§ 295 f.

נוץ.def:

I. [נָצָה‎] verb fly (?); — only

נחץ.def:
H369. ayin

II. אַ֫יִן‎ nought.

אִיעֶזֶר‎ see אֲבִיעֶזֶר‎.

אִיתָמָר‎ see I. אָוָה‎.

II. אָ֑֫יִן אַ֫יִן,‎ construct אֵין‎

substantive properly nothing, nought (Moabite אן‎, Assyrian iânu).

1 Isa 40:23 לְאָ֑יִן רוֺזְנִים הַנּוֺתֵן‎ who bringeth princes to nothing; כְּאַיִן‎ as nothing, ib. 40:17; 41:11-12, Hag 2:3; Psa 39:6; almost (|| כִּמְעַט‎) 73:2; מֵאַיִן‎ of nothing Isa 41:24.

2 construct אֵין‎, very frequently as

particle of negations, is not, are not, was not, were not, etc. (corresponding to the affirmative יֵשׁ‎ q. v. Similar in usage, though not etymology akin, are , לַיִת‎, , , properly 'there is nought of ...' followed by a substantive or a pronominal suffix (אֵינֶנִּי‎ [verbal form, Ges§ 100, 5; 152, 1 c], אֵינָם אֵינְכֶם, אֵינֶנָּה, אֵינֶנּוּ, אֵינֵךְ, אֵינְךָ,‎, also Psa 59:14 אֵינֵ֫מוֺ‎, 73:5 אֵינֵ֫ימוֺ‎): twice abnormally, in late Hebrew, a noun אֲנַחְנוּ אֵין אֲנִי, אֵין‎ Neh 4:17 (so sometimes לַיִת‎, , NöM. p. 295); once, incorrectly, את‎ Hag 2:17.

a. denying existence absolutely Isa 44:6; 47:10 רֹאָנִי אֵין‎ there is none that seeth me, literally nought of one seeing me! עוֺד אֵין‎ there is none else Deut 4:39; 1Kin 8:60; Isa 45:5-6, 18, 22.

b. more commonly, in a limited sense, there is none here or at hand Exod 2:12 and he saw אִישׁ כִּיאֵֿין‎ that there was no man (that is, there), Num 21:5; Gen 5:24 וְאֵינֶנּוּ‎ and he was not (of Enoch's disappearance from earth) 42:13 one (cas. pend. as often), he is not, 42:36; often = is (or has) vanished 37:30; 1Kin 20:40; Isa 17:14; Psa 37:10; 103:16; Job 8:22; 24:24; 27:19.

c. with the sense determined by a predicate following: Gen 37:29 Joseph was not in the pit, 41:39 + often; Exod 5:10 תֶּבֶן לָכֶם נֹתֵן אֵינֶנִּי‎ I am not giving you straw; and so often with particip. where duration has to be expressed Gen 39:23; Deut 21:18; Isa 1:15; Jer 7:16, or intention Gen 20:7 אִם ֗֗֗ דַּע מֵשִׁיב אֵינְךָ‎ if thou art not restoring her, know 43:5; Exod 8:17; 33:15 (idiomatically, after אם‎; see Dr§ 137) Judg 12:3. Following once pleonastic by יֵשׁ‎ Psa 135:17. Treated as a mere particle of negation, אֵין‎ may vary its position in the sentence, the substantive which should strictly stand in the Genitive being not only separated from it by a little word, as בּוֺ‎ Gen 37:24, לוֺ‎ Exod 22:1, שָׁם‎ 12:30, גַּם‎ Psa 14:3, etc., but even for emphasis prefixed to it, as Gen 19:31; 40:8 אֹתוֺ אֵין וּפֹתֵר‎ 41:15; Exod 5:16; Judg 13:9; 14:6; 16:15; 19:1 (so MI24): if however it be thus brought to the end of a sentence, or be disconnected with what follows, it stands in the absolute form, as Gen 2:5 האדמה לעבד אַיִן ואדם‎ and man there was none to till the ground, Lev 26:37 אָ֑יִן וְרֹדֵף‎ Num 20:5; 2Kin 19:3; Hosea 13:4; Micah 7:2.

d. sometimes the subject has to be supplied from the context: thus (α) 1Sam 9:4 and they passed through the land of Shaalim וָאַיִן‎ and they (the asses) were not (literally and nought!), especially after verbs of waiting or seeking Isa 59:11; Psa 69:21; Job 3:9; Isa 41:17. Ezek 7:25; Prov 14:6; 13:4; 20:4. (β) Exod 17:7 is ׳י‎ in the midst of us ׃ אִםאָֽֿיִן‎ or not ? Num 13:20. (γ) Judg 4:20 אָֽיִן׃ וְאָמַרְתְּ‎ then thou shalt say, There is not, 1Kin 18:10; 1Sam 10:14. (δ) Gen 30:1 give me children, וְאִםאַֿיִן‎ and if not, I die, Exod 32:32; Judg 9:15, 20; 2Sam 17:6 (see Dr) 2Kin 2:10; Job 33:33.

e. with subject not expressed, once (late), Dan 8:5 בָּאָרֶץ נֹגֵעַ וְאֵין‎ and (it) was not touching the earth. feminine once, Job 35:15 with the finite verb; but read here מֹּקֵד אֵין כִּי‎ (the usage of , cited by De, does not justify the anomaly in Hebrew) Jer 38:5 the imperfect may be due to the fact that no participle of יָכֹל‎ was in use, and a relation must be tacitly supplied: 'The king is not (one that) can do aught against you.' On Exod 3:2 see Ges§ 52, 2 R. 6; Ew§ 169 d.

3 לְ ׳אֵין‎, with substantive, or pronoun, there is (was) not to . . . = . . . have, has, had, etc. not: Gen 11:30 וָלָד לָהּ אֵין‎ she had no child, Num 27:9 בַּת לוֺ וְאִםאֵֿין‎ and if he have no daughter + often; with a participle Deut 22:27; Jer 14:16; 30:17; 49:5; 50:32; Psa 142:5; Lam 1:2, 9, 17; Exod 22:2 לוֺ אִםאֵֿין‎ if he have nought, Dan 9:26 לו ואין‎ and have nought (or none).

4 in circumstantial clauses (Dr§ 164): — (a) Exod 21:11 she shall go out free כָּ֑סֶף אֵין‎ without money, 22:9 רֹאֶה אֵין‎ none seeing it, Num 11:6; Isa 47:1; Jer 2:32; Hosea 3:4; 7:11; Psa 32:9; 88:5 + . (b) Deut 32:4 a God of faithfulness עָוֶל וְאֵין‎ and no iniquity, i.e. without iniquity, Jer 5:21; Joel 1:6; Psa 104:25. (c) very often, in such phrases as מַחֲרִיד וְאֵין‎ with none to affright Lev 26:6 (12 t.); מְכַבֶּה וְאֵין‎ Isa 1:31 and elsewhere; מַצִּיל וְאֵין‎ 5:29; Psa 7:3, etc. (Dr§ 159).

5 with infinitive and ׳ל‎, it is not to . . . : i.e. (a) like οὐκ ἔστιν, it is not possible to . . . (compare below יֵשׁ‎ and לֹא‎), but hardly except in late Hebrew; 2Chr 20:6 לְהִתְיַצֵּב עִמְּךָ וְאֵין‎ it is not possible to stand (in conflict) with thee, 22:9; Ezra 9:15; Eccl 3:14; Est 4:2. Once without ל‎, Psa 40:6 אֵלָיךָ עֲרֹךְ אֵין‎ οὐκ ἔστι παραβάλλειν σοι. (β) there is no need to . . . 1Chr 23:26 אֵיןלָֿשֵׂאת לַלְוִיִּם וְגַם‎ for the Levites also there was no need to bear 2Chr 5:11; 35:15 (see Dr§ 202. 1).

6 with prefixes : —

a. בְּאֵין‎ properly in defect of: — (a) for want of, without — Prov 5:23 HE will die מוּסָר בְּאֵין‎ for lack of instruction, 11:14 תַּחְבֻּלוֺת בְּאֵין‎ without guidance, 14:4; 15:22; 26:20; 29:18; Isa 57:1; Ezek 38:11; compare בְּלֹא‎. (β) of time = when there was (were) not Prov 8:24 (twice in verse).

b. כְּאֵין‎ Isa 59:10 עֵינַיִם כְּאֵין‎ in poetry for עֵינַיִם לוֺ אֵין כַּאֲשֶׁר‎ (compare Ew§ 286 g Ges§ 152. 1 h).

c. לְאֵין‎ (α) for לוֺ אֵין לַאֲשֶׁר‎ Isa 40:29; inlate prose 2Chr 14:10; Neh 8:10. (β) in the condition of not. . . (ל‎ of state, see below ל‎) = without or so that not . . . (peculiar to Chronicles), 1Chr 22:4 cedar trees מִסְמָּר לְאֵין‎ without number, 2Chr 14:12 and there fell of the Cushites מִחְיָה לְאֵיןלָֿהֶם‎ so that they had none remaining alive, 20:25 מַשָּׂא לְאֵין‎ so that there was no carrying away, 21:18; Ezra 9:14. (γ) עַדלְֿאֵין‎ (see ל ׳עַד‎), 2Chr 36:16 until there was no remedy (compare ֗֗֗ אֵין עַד‎ Psa 40:13; Job 5:9).

d. מֵאֵין‎ (a) (מִן‎ causal) from lack of . . . Isa 50:2; Jer 7:32; 19:11. (β) (מִן‎ negative, see מִן‎) properly away from there being no. . . (with אֵין‎ pleonastic, compare מִבְּלִי‎, and אֵין מִבְּלִי‎), i.e. so that not. . ., without, mostly epexegetical of some term expressing desolation: Isa 5:9 Surely many houses shall be desolate יוֺשֵׁב מֵאֵין‎ without inhabitant, 6:11 +? Jeremiah & Zephaniah; 6:11 אָדָם מֵאֵין‎, Jer 32:43 וּבְהֵמָה אָדָם מֵאֵין‎ 33:10, 12; Ezek 33:28; Lam 3:49. Once followed by infinitive Mal 2:13 so that there is no regarding more. (γ) in Jer 10:6-7, מֵאֵין כָּמוֺךָ, מֵאֵין‎ is supposed by some to = a strengthened אֵין‎, even none, none at all; but it is difficult to justify this explanation logically; and it is preferable to point כָּמוֺךָ מֵאַיִן‎ whence is any like thee? compare 30:7. (So Hi see DrHebraica. ii. 34-7.)

I. נְח֫שֶׁת‎137 noun masculine1Kin 7:45 (compare AlbrZAW xvi (1896), 108; feminine1 Chronicles 18:8) copper, bronze (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Phoenician נחשת‎; Palmyrene נחשא‎ Lzb322; Syriac , נְחָשָׁא ᵑ7‎, Arabic , Ethiopic (so also Old Ethiopic DHMEpigr.Denkm.aus Abess.(1894),52); WMMAs.u.Eur.127 cites Egyptian teµ(µ)ost, copper (= *tenµost), as loan-word from נְחשֶׁת‎ + feminine article); — ׳נ‎ absolute Gen 4:22 +; construct Exod 38:29; suffix נְחֻשְׁתִּי‎ Lam 3:7, נְחֻשְׁתֵךְ‎ Ezek 16:36, נְחֻשְׁתָּהּ‎ 24:11, נְחֻשְׁתָּם‎ 2Kin 25:13 2t.; dual נְחֻשְׁתַּ֫יִם‎ Judg 16:21 6t.; —

On ׳נ קָלָל‎ Ezek 1:7; Dan 10:6 see קלל‎; ׳נ‎ as spoil of war 2Sam 8:8; 2Kin 25:13 = Jer 52:17, 20 etc.

H5186. natah

נָטָה‎215 verb stretch out, spread out, extend, incline, bend (Late Hebrew id., incline, spread tent, etc.; Arabic stretch out); —

Qal137 Perfect3masculine singular ׳נ‎ Gen 33:19 +; 3 feminine singular נָָֽכְתָה‎ Num 22:33; 2masculine singular נָטִיתָ‎ Exod 15:12; 3plural נָטוּ‎ Psalm 21:42; Isa 45:12, נָטָ֫יוּ‎ Psa 73:2 Qr, etc.; Imperfect יִטֶּה‎ Job 15:29, jussive יֵט‎ Zeph 2:13; וַיֵּט‎ Gen 12:8 +, וַיֶּטֿ‎ 26:27; 1Chr 15:1; 3feminine singular תִּטֶּה‎ Job 31:7, וַתֵּט‎ Num 22:23 2t.; 2 masculine singular jussive תֵּט‎ Prov 4:5, 27; 3masculine plural וַיִּטּוּ‎ 1Sam 8:3; 1plural נִטֶּה‎ Num 20:17; 21:22; Imperative נְטֵה‎ Exod 8:1 +; Infinitive construct נְטוֺת‎ Judg 19:8 4t., נְטֹת‎ Exod 23:2; suffix נְטֹתִי‎ 7:5, נְטוֺתוֺ‎ Psa 109:23; Participle active נֹטֶה‎ Jer 10:20 6t., נוֺטֶה‎ Ezek 25:16 3t.; suffix נוֺטֵיהָם‎ Isa 42:5; passive נָטוּי‎ Psa 62:4 2t., + 73:2 (see below); feminine singular נְטוּיָה‎ Isa 5:25 24t., plural נְטֻיוֺת‎ 3:16 Qr (Kt נטוות‎): —

1. a. stretch out, extend, hand, rod, usually with accusative + עַל‎ of direction Exod 9:22-23, 10:12-13, 21, 22 (all E), 7:19; 14:16, 21, 26, 27 (all P), absolute Josh 8:19 (JE), Exod 8:12 (P); with ב‎ of dart or rod ׳נ אֶלֿ בַּכִּידוֺן‎ Josh 8:18 (twice in verse) (JE), ׳נ עַלֿ בְּמַטֶּ֔ךָ יָָֽדְךָ‎ Exod 8:1 (P), compare 8:2 and (עַל‎ omitted) 8:13 (all P), Josh 8:26 (JE); figurative of hostility to God ׳נ אֶלֿ יָדוֺ‎ Job 15:25; especially of God stretching out his hand over (עַל‎) often with idea of against, i.e. in judgment, Isa 5:25; 23:11; Zeph 1:4; 2:13; Ezek 6:14 7t. Ezekiel; Exod 7:5 (P); with אֶלֿ‎ against Joel Ex 51:25, compare sword Ezek 30:25; absolute Exod 15:12 (song); passive participle ׳נ גָּרוֺן‎ Isa 3:16 outstretched of neck; often נְטוּיָה זְרוֺע‎ arm stretched out (of ׳י‎) to deliver, Deut 4:34 14t. (see זְרוֺעַ‎); נ ׳אֶזְרוֺעַ‎ Jer 32:21; נ ׳יָד‎, to oppose, 21:5; נְטוּיָה יָדוֺ עוֺד‎ in judgment, Isa 5:25 (|| אַמּוֺ שָׁב לֹא‎), so 9:11; 9:16; 9:20; 10:4 (all || id.), compare 14:27; עַלֿ הַנְּטוּיָה הַיָּד‎ 14:26; יָדִי נָטִיתִי‎ Prov 1:24 (of wisdom's appeal; || קָרָאתִי‎).

b. stretch line and plummet,

c. עַל‎ 2Kin 21:13 (subject ׳י‎ figurative of destruction), compare Isa 34:11; Lam 2:8; line, of artisan's measurements (absolute) Isa 44:13, and (with עַל‎) Job 38:5.

c. = offer, only עָלֶיךָ נֹטֶה אֲנִי שָׁלוֺשׁ‎ 1Chr 21:10 three things do I offer unto thee (so read probably also || 2Sam 24:12, see נטל‎).

2 Spread out, i.e. pitch, tent Gen 12:8; 26:25; 35:21 (all J), 33:19 (E), Judg 4:11, compare Jer 43:10; figurative of establishing people 10:20; of sacred tent Exod 33:7 (JE), 2Sam 6:17 = 1Chr 16:1; 15:1; 2Chr 1:14; object heavens (spread out by ׳י‎ as tent) Jer 10:12 9t., compare Job 26:7; object likeness of firmament in Ezekiel's vision Ezek 1:22.

3 Bend, turn, incline:

a. intransitive, of wady Num 21:15 (J E; with לְ‎); turn aside, of Balaam's ass 22:23 (מִןהַֿדֶּרֶךְ‎), 22:33 (מִמָּנַי‎), compare 22:33 (לְפָנַי‎); with adverb accusative 22:26, so of Israel 20:17, and (with מֵעָלָיו‎) 20:21; with ב‎ into, 21:22; of individual 2Sam 2:19 (עַל לָלֶכֶת‎), 2:21 (עַל‎), Jer 14:8 (c. infinitive); compare Gen 38:1 (עַד‎), 38:16 (אֶלֿ‎); figurative of deviating from path of loyalty 1Kin 2:28 (with אַחֲרֵי‎), compare Judg 9:3 (of heart), or of righteousness Exod 23:2 [yet on text compare BuZAW xi (1891), 113 Ryon the passage], 1Sam 8:3 (all with אַחֲרֵי‎); with מִן‎ Job 31:7; Psa 44:19, compare Prov 4:5 and (c. adverb accusative) 4:27; י ׳מֵעִם‎ 1Kin 11:9 (of heart), compare Psa 119:51; 119:157; incline, (of heart), with לְ‎ 1Sam 14:7 (read נָטָה לְבָֽבְךָ‎ or ׳ל נֹטֶה‎ Th We Dr Klo Bu HPS Löhr); decline, of shadow on dial 2Kin 20:10 (|| הָלַךְ‎, opposed to אֲחֹרַנִּית שׁוּב‎), figurative of failing life Psa 102:12; 109:23; of day Judg 19:8 + 19:9 (text emendations, see GFM); bend down, לָאָרֶץ יִטֶּה‎ Job 15:29, בָּאָרֶץ לִנְטוֺת‎ Psa 17:11 (both dubious, see Commentaries); apparently בְּכֹחַ וַיֵּט‎ Judg 16:30 and he bowed with all his might (after וַיִּסָּמֵךְ וַיִּלְמֹּת,‎; al. stretched himself i.e. gave a thrust, Be GFM, but verb less often intransitive in this sense); of אֵלַי וַיֵּט ׳י,‎ Psa 40:2 and he inclined unto me, — הַמִּלְחָמָה וַתֵּט‎ is read 1Sam 4:2 by ᵐ5‎ Dr Klo Bu, compare נָטַשׁ‎
